ko.title: 대법원 승소, 하지만 수표는 아직: 아무도 받을 수 없는 1,650억 달러 관세 환급의 내막

segments.src: There is a peculiar kind of legal victory in which you win everything and receive nothing.
segments.tr: 모든 것을 이겼지만 아무것도 받지 못하는 기묘한 종류의 법적 승리가 있습니다.

segments.src: Somewhere around 330,000 American importers are living in it right now.
segments.tr: 현재 약 33만 명의 미국 수입업자들이 바로 그런 상황에 처해 있습니다.

segments.src: Six months after the Supreme Court held, 6–3, that the International Emergency Economic Powers Act does not give any president the authority to impose tariffs, the courts have ordered roughly $165 billion in collected duties returned to the companies that paid them.
segments.tr: 대법원이 국제비상경제권한법(IEEPA)이 대통령에게 관세를 부과할 권한을 부여하지 않는다고 6대 3으로 판결한 지 6개월이 지났고, 법원은 징수된 관세 약 1,650억 달러를 납부한 기업들에 돌려주라고 명령했습니다.

segments.src: On paper, that is one of the largest single refund events the U.S.
segments.tr: 서류상으로는 미국

segments.src: Treasury has ever faced.
segments.tr: 재무부가 직면한 단일 환급 사례 중 최대 규모 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: In practice, most of the businesses entitled to that money have not seen a dollar of it — and a large share of them are still cutting tariff checks every week.
segments.tr: 실제로는 환급 대상인 대부분의 기업이 단 1달러도 받지 못했으며, 그들 중 상당수는 여전히 매주 관세 수표를 발행하고 있습니다.

segments.src: The gap between the ruling and the refund is not a scandal.
segments.tr: 판결과 환급 사이의 간극은 스캔들이 아닙니다.

segments.src: It is plumbing.
segments.tr: 그것은 행정적 절차(plumbing)의 문제입니다.

segments.src: But the plumbing is worth understanding, because it explains why a landmark constitutional decision has so far changed far less about the cost of importing goods into the United States than the headline suggested.
segments.tr: 하지만 이 행정적 절차를 이해하는 것이 중요합니다. 왜냐하면 획기적인 헌법적 결정이 헤드라인에서 시사한 것보다 미국으로 상품을 수입하는 비용에 대해 지금까지 훨씬 적은 변화를 가져왔는지를 설명해주기 때문입니다.

segments.src: ## What the Court actually decided
segments.tr: ## 법원이 실제로 결정한 것

segments.src: IEEPA, passed in 1977, lets a president declare a national emergency in response to an "unusual and extraordinary threat" originating largely outside the United States, and then take a list of economic actions — among them, the authority to "regulate ...
segments.tr: 1977년에 통과된 IEEPA는 대통령이 주로 미국 외부에서 발생하는 "비정상적이고 특별한 위협"에 대응하여 국가 비상사태를 선포하고, 그에 따라 일련의 경제적 조치를 취할 수 있게 합니다. 여기에는 "... 규제할 수 있는 권한"이 포함됩니다.

segments.src: importation."
segments.tr: 수입(importation)."

segments.src: The government's argument rested on those three words.
segments.tr: 정부의 주장은 이 세 단어에 근거했습니다.

segments.src: If you can regulate importation, the reasoning went, you can condition importation on payment of a duty.
segments.tr: 수입을 규제할 수 있다면, 관세 납부를 수입의 조건으로 걸 수 있다는 논리였습니다.

segments.src: Emergencies are unpredictable, and Congress wrote the statute broadly on purpose.
segments.tr: 비상사태는 예측 불가능하며, 의회는 의도적으로 법령을 광범위하게 작성했다는 것입니다.

segments.src: The challengers — a group of small importers and a coalition of states, whose cases were consolidated on the way up — made a structural argument instead.
segments.tr: 반면, 소규모 수입업자 그룹과 주 정부 연합으로 구성된 원고 측은 구조적인 주장을 펼쳤습니다.

segments.src: The power to lay duties belongs to Congress under Article I.
segments.tr: 관세를 부과할 권한은 헌법 제1조에 따라 의회에 있다는 것입니다.

segments.src: IEEPA never uses the words *tariff*, *duty*, or *tax*.
segments.tr: IEEPA에는 *관세(tariff)*, *세금(duty)* 또는 *조세(tax)*라는 단어가 전혀 사용되지 않았습니다.

segments.src: And in nearly fifty years, across administrations of both parties, no president had ever read the statute that way.
segments.tr: 그리고 거의 50년 동안, 양당 정부를 거치며 어떤 대통령도 이 법령을 그렇게 해석한 적이 없었습니다.

segments.src: The majority sided with the challengers, applying the now-familiar principle that Congress does not hide decisions of vast economic and political significance inside vague or ancillary statutory language.
segments.tr: 다수 의견은 원고 측의 손을 들어주었습니다. 의회는 막대한 경제적, 정치적 중요성을 가진 결정을 모호하거나 부수적인 법적 문구 속에 숨기지 않는다는 이제는 익숙한 원칙을 적용한 것입니다.

segments.src: The Court noted something telling: when Congress *has* delegated tariff authority, it has done so deliberately and with guardrails — required investigations, agency findings, rate ceilings, sunset clauses.
segments.tr: 법원은 시사하는 바가 큰 점을 지적했습니다. 의회가 관세 권한을 위임했을 때는 항상 신중하게, 그리고 안전장치를 두어 그렇게 했습니다. 즉, 조사 필요성, 기관의 결과 보고, 세율 상한선, 일몰 조항 등을 둔 것입니다.

segments.src: IEEPA has none of those.
segments.tr: IEEPA에는 그런 것이 전혀 없습니다.

segments.src: The absence of any procedural machinery was treated as evidence that the machinery was never meant to be there.
segments.tr: 절차적 장치의 부재는 그러한 장치가 애초에 의도되지 않았다는 증거로 취급되었습니다.

segments.src: The dissent argued for deference in the field of foreign affairs, and read "regulate importation" as plainly capacious enough to include a tariff.
segments.tr: 반대 의견은 외교 분야에서의 존중을 주장하며, "수입 규제"라는 표현이 관세를 포함할 만큼 충분히 포괄적이라고 해석했습니다.

segments.src: One point gets lost in the coverage: the decision is about *which branch* sets tariffs and *under which statute*.
segments.tr: 보도에서 간과되는 점 하나는, 이 결정이 *어느 기관*이 *어떤 법령*에 따라 관세를 설정하는지에 관한 것이라는 점입니다.

segments.src: It is not a ruling on whether tariffs are wise policy.
segments.tr: 관세가 현명한 정책인지에 대한 판결이 아닙니다.

segments.src: That distinction explains nearly everything that has happened since.
segments.tr: 이 구분이 이후에 일어난 거의 모든 일을 설명해 줍니다.

segments.src: ## Why winning is not the same as being paid
segments.tr: ## 승소가 곧 지급을 의미하지 않는 이유

segments.src: Customs refunds do not work like a court-ordered settlement where a check gets mailed.
segments.tr: 세관 환급은 수표가 우편으로 발송되는 법원 명령 합의금처럼 작동하지 않습니다.

segments.src: They work entry by entry, through a system built for correcting individual paperwork errors, not for unwinding a policy applied to tens of millions of shipments.
segments.tr: 환급은 수천만 건의 선적물에 적용된 정책을 되돌리는 것이 아니라, 개별 서류상의 오류를 수정하기 위해 구축된 시스템을 통해 항목별(entry by entry)로 진행됩니다.

segments.src: **Liquidation is the deadline nobody outside the trade world had heard of.** When goods enter the United States, the importer files an entry summary and deposits estimated duties.
segments.tr: **청산(Liquidation)은 무역 업계 외부 사람들은 들어본 적 없는 마감일입니다.** 상품이 미국에 들어올 때, 수입업자는 수입 신고서(entry summary)를 제출하고 추정 관세를 예치합니다.

segments.src: Months later, Customs and Border Protection "liquidates" the entry — the final, legally binding computation of what was owed.
segments.tr: 몇 달 후, 세관국경보호국(CBP)은 해당 수입 건을 "청산"합니다. 즉, 납부해야 할 금액에 대한 최종적이고 법적 구속력이 있는 계산을 완료하는 것입니다.

segments.src: Once an entry liquidates and the protest window closes, it is generally final.
segments.tr: 수입 건이 청산되고 이의 제기 기간이 종료되면, 일반적으로 최종 확정됩니다.

segments.src: Reopening it requires a specific legal hook.
segments.tr: 이를 다시 열기 위해서는 특정한 법적 근거가 필요합니다.

segments.src: Many entries from the tariffs' earliest months liquidated long before the case reached the Supreme Court, and a meaningful slice of the theoretical $165 billion sits behind that door.
segments.tr: 관세 부과 초기 몇 달 동안의 많은 수입 건들이 대법원 판결이 나오기 훨씬 전에 이미 청산되었으며, 이론적인 1,650억 달러 중 상당 부분이 그 문 뒤에 갇혀 있습니다.

segments.src: **Being right is not the same as being a party.** Court orders run to the parties before the court.
segments.tr: **옳다는 것이 당사자가 되는 것과 같지는 않습니다.** 법원 명령은 법원에 제기된 당사자들에게 적용됩니다.

segments.src: Whether relief extends automatically to every importer in the country, or whether each company must file its own protest or suit to claim its share, has been litigated separately — and that secondary fight is where a great deal of the money is currently parked.
segments.tr: 구제책이 국가의 모든 수입업자에게 자동으로 확장되는지, 아니면 각 기업이 자신의 몫을 청구하기 위해 개별적으로 이의 제기나 소송을 제기해야 하는지는 별도로 다투어 왔으며, 현재 많은 자금이 이 2차 분쟁에 묶여 있습니다.

segments.src: Importers who filed protective claims early are in a materially better position than those who waited for the news.
segments.tr: 초기에 보호 청구를 제기한 수입업자들은 소식을 기다렸던 이들보다 실질적으로 훨씬 유리한 위치에 있습니다.

segments.src: **The refund itself is an accounting exercise at enormous scale.** CBP processes tens of millions of entry summaries a year.
segments.tr: **환급 자체는 엄청난 규모의 회계 작업입니다.** CBP는 연간 수천만 건의 수입 신고서를 처리합니다.

segments.src: Each refund has to be matched to a specific entry, a specific line, a specific tariff classification, and often a specific surety bond.
segments.tr: 각 환급금은 특정 수입 건, 특정 라인, 특정 관세 분류, 그리고 종종 특정 보증 보험(surety bond)과 일치해야 합니다.

segments.src: Some entries mixed duties that are now void with duties that remain perfectly valid under other statutes.
segments.tr: 일부 수입 건에는 현재 무효가 된 관세와 다른 법령에 따라 여전히 유효한 관세가 섞여 있습니다.

segments.src: Untangling those lines is manual work, and there is no button that does it.
segments.tr: 이 라인들을 구분해내는 것은 수작업이며, 이를 자동으로 처리하는 버튼은 없습니다.

segments.src: **Interest accrues, which softens the wait but complicates the math.** Excess deposits generally carry interest from the date of deposit until refund, at rates Treasury resets quarterly.
segments.tr: **이자가 발생하며, 이는 기다림의 고통을 덜어주지만 계산을 복잡하게 만듭니다.** 초과 예치금은 일반적으로 예치일부터 환급일까지 재무부가 분기별로 재설정하는 이율로 이자가 붙습니다.

segments.src: For a company that paid millions in 2025, that is real money — and also a taxable event landing in a different fiscal year than the original expense.
segments.tr: 2025년에 수백만 달러를 납부한 기업에게 이는 실제 돈이며, 또한 원래 비용이 발생한 해와 다른 회계 연도에 발생하는 과세 대상 사건이 됩니다.

segments.src: **Appeals and remands keep resetting the clock.** Even after a Supreme Court ruling on the core question, the downstream cases about scope, timing, and eligibility continue to move through the Court of International Trade and the Federal Circuit.
segments.tr: **항소와 파기 환송이 시계를 계속 리셋합니다.** 핵심 쟁점에 대한 대법원 판결 이후에도, 범위, 시기, 자격에 관한 하급심 사건들이 국제무역법원(CIT)과 연방 순회항소법원을 통해 계속 진행되고 있습니다.

segments.src: Every remand adds months.
segments.tr: 파기 환송이 일어날 때마다 몇 달이 추가됩니다.

segments.src: ## Who actually gets the money
segments.tr: ## 실제로 돈을 받는 사람은 누구인가

segments.src: This is the question that produces the most awkward conversations inside companies.
segments.tr: 이 질문은 기업 내부에서 가장 어색한 대화를 만들어냅니다.

segments.src: The refund goes to the **importer of record** — the entity legally on the hook to CBP.
segments.tr: 환급금은 **수입 기록상 수입자(importer of record)**, 즉 CBP에 대해 법적 책임을 지는 주체에게 돌아갑니다.

segments.src: That is often not the party that ultimately bore the cost.
segments.tr: 하지만 이는 종종 최종적으로 비용을 부담한 당사자가 아닙니다.

segments.src: A U.S.
segments.tr: 관세를 납부하고 가격을 올린 미국의

segments.src: distributor that paid the duty and raised its prices has already recovered much of it from customers.
segments.tr: 유통업체는 이미 고객으로부터 그 비용의 상당 부분을 회수했습니다.

segments.src: A retailer that negotiated delivered-duty-paid terms may have pushed the cost onto a foreign supplier.
segments.tr: 관세 지급 인도 조건(DDP)을 협상한 소매업체는 비용을 해외 공급업체에 전가했을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Some contracts contain explicit tariff-adjustment clauses that now run in reverse; most do not.
segments.tr: 일부 계약에는 이제 역방향으로 작동하는 명시적인 관세 조정 조항이 포함되어 있지만, 대부분은 그렇지 않습니다.

segments.src: The result is a wave of quiet commercial negotiation that has nothing to do with the constitutional question: *who, in this supply chain, owns this receivable?* Companies with clean documentation and well-drafted clauses are resolving it in weeks.
segments.tr: 그 결과, 헌법적 질문과는 무관한 조용한 상업적 협상이 물결처럼 일어납니다. *이 공급망에서 이 미수금의 소유권은 누구에게 있는가?* 서류가 깔끔하고 조항이 잘 작성된 기업들은 몇 주 만에 이를 해결하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Companies without are discovering that a windfall is only a windfall if you can prove it is yours.
segments.tr: 그렇지 않은 기업들은 횡재는 그것이 자신의 것임을 증명할 수 있을 때만 횡재라는 사실을 깨닫고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The wall that replaced the wall
segments.tr: ## 벽을 대체한 벽

segments.src: Here is the part that surprises people who followed only the headline.
segments.tr: 헤드라인만 따라간 사람들이 놀라는 부분이 여기입니다.

segments.src: For many importers, the total duty burden has not fallen much, because the tariffs did not disappear so much as change legal address.
segments.tr: 많은 수입업자에게 총 관세 부담은 크게 줄어들지 않았습니다. 관세가 사라졌다기보다 법적 근거지가 바뀌었기 때문입니다.

segments.src: IEEPA was the fast lane.
segments.tr: IEEPA는 급행 차선이었습니다.

segments.src: Everything else is slower, narrower, and procedurally demanding — but it exists, and it has been used.
segments.tr: 다른 모든 방법은 더 느리고, 더 좁으며, 절차적으로 까다롭지만, 존재하며 실제로 사용되어 왔습니다.

segments.src: | Authority | What it requires | Practical constraints |
segments.tr: | 권한 | 요구 사항 | 실질적 제약 |

segments.src: | **Section 232** (Trade Expansion Act of 1962) | Commerce Department investigation finding that imports threaten national security | Product-by-product; investigations take months; no statutory rate cap |
segments.tr: | **제232조** (1962년 무역확장법) | 수입품이 국가 안보를 위협한다는 상무부 조사 결과 | 품목별 진행; 조사는 수개월 소요; 법적 세율 상한선 없음 |

segments.src: | **Section 301** (Trade Act of 1974) | USTR investigation into unfair foreign practices | Country-specific; notice-and-comment; subject to periodic review |
segments.tr: | **제301조** (1974년 무역법) | 불공정 외국 관행에 대한 USTR(미국 무역대표부) 조사 | 국가별 적용; 공고 및 의견 수렴; 정기적 검토 대상 |

segments.src: | **Section 201** (Trade Act of 1974) | ITC finding of serious injury to a domestic industry | Temporary safeguard; must phase down over time |
segments.tr: | **제201조** (1974년 무역법) | 국내 산업에 심각한 피해를 입혔다는 ITC(국제무역위원회) 결과 | 일시적 세이프가드; 시간이 지남에 따라 단계적 축소 필요 |

segments.src: | **Section 122** (Trade Act of 1974) | Balance-of-payments justification | Capped at 15% and 150 days without congressional action |
segments.tr: | **제122조** (1974년 무역법) | 국제수지 정당화 | 의회 조치 없이는 15% 상한 및 150일 제한 |

segments.src: Section 232 has done most of the work.
segments.tr: 제232조가 대부분의 역할을 수행했습니다.

segments.src: Because it is organized around product categories rather than countries, rebuilding coverage means running investigations sector by sector — steel and aluminum derivatives, autos and parts, copper, timber and lumber, pharmaceuticals, semiconductors and downstream electronics.
segments.tr: 국가가 아닌 제품 카테고리를 중심으로 구성되기 때문에, 적용 범위를 재구축한다는 것은 부문별로 조사를 실시한다는 것을 의미합니다. 철강 및 알루미늄 파생상품, 자동차 및 부품, 구리, 목재 및 재목, 의약품, 반도체 및 하위 전자제품 등이 그 대상입니다.

segments.src: Each one is a separate proceeding with its own comment docket and its own effective date.
segments.tr: 각각은 고유한 의견 수렴 기록과 효력 발생일을 가진 별도의 절차입니다.

segments.src: The practical effect for an importer is that a refund for last year's duties can arrive in the same quarter as a new invoice for this year's, on the same product, at a comparable rate, under a different statute.
segments.tr: 수입업자가 느끼는 실질적인 효과는, 작년 관세에 대한 환급금이 들어오는 같은 분기에, 동일한 제품에 대해 다른 법령에 근거하여 비슷한 세율로 올해의 새로운 청구서가 도착한다는 것입니다.

segments.src: The money is real.
segments.tr: 돈은 실제하지만,

segments.src: The relief is not.
segments.tr: 구제는 실제하지 않습니다.

segments.src: ## What it means for the books
segments.tr: ## 장부상의 의미

segments.src: Accountants have been unusually vocal about this one.
segments.tr: 회계사들이 이 문제에 대해 유독 목소리를 높여왔습니다.

segments.src: Under U.S.
segments.tr: 미국

segments.src: GAAP, gain contingencies generally are not recognized until realized or realizable — so a company cannot simply book its expected refund as an asset because it read a favorable opinion.
segments.tr: GAAP(일반적으로 인정된 회계원칙)에 따르면, 이익 우발채무는 일반적으로 실현되거나 실현 가능해질 때까지 인식되지 않습니다. 따라서 기업이 유리한 판결문을 읽었다고 해서 예상 환급금을 단순히 자산으로 잡을 수는 없습니다.

segments.src: The original tariffs were typically expensed through cost of goods sold or capitalized into inventory.
segments.tr: 원래 관세는 일반적으로 매출원가로 비용 처리되거나 재고 자산으로 자본화되었습니다.

segments.src: The refunds, when they land, tend to arrive as a lump in a later period, distorting margins in a quarter that had nothing to do with the shipments in question.
segments.tr: 환급금은 들어올 때 나중에 일시불로 들어오는 경향이 있어, 해당 선적물과 아무런 관련이 없는 분기의 마진을 왜곡하게 됩니다.

segments.src: That timing mismatch is why some importers with large confirmed claims still look, on paper, like they are absorbing tariff costs.
segments.tr: 이러한 타이밍의 불일치 때문에, 확정된 대규모 청구권을 가진 일부 수입업자들이 서류상으로는 여전히 관세 비용을 부담하고 있는 것처럼 보입니다.

segments.src: They are — until the money moves.
segments.tr: 돈이 움직이기 전까지는 실제로 그렇습니다.

segments.src: ## What it means for prices
segments.tr: ## 가격에 미치는 영향

segments.src: Prices are famously sticky downward.
segments.tr: 가격은 하방 경직성이 강하기로 유명합니다.

segments.src: Costs that got passed to consumers over two years do not reverse on the day a court rules, particularly when replacement duties are landing in the same categories.
segments.tr: 2년 동안 소비자에게 전가된 비용은 법원이 판결하는 날 바로 되돌아가지 않습니다. 특히 대체 관세가 동일한 카테고리에 적용될 때 더욱 그렇습니다.

segments.src: Where relief has shown up fastest is in goods that fell outside every Section 232 product scope — certain consumer categories, some apparel and household goods, various inputs with no plausible national-security framing.
segments.tr: 구제가 가장 빠르게 나타난 곳은 제232조의 모든 제품 범위에서 벗어난 상품들입니다. 특정 소비자 카테고리, 일부 의류 및 가정용품, 국가 안보 프레임으로 묶을 수 없는 다양한 투입재들이 이에 해당합니다.

segments.src: Where it has shown up least is anywhere touching metals, vehicles, electronics, or pharmaceuticals.
segments.tr: 가장 적게 나타난 곳은 금속, 차량, 전자제품 또는 의약품과 관련된 모든 곳입니다.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 앞으로 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: - **The scope litigation.** Whether relief reaches non-parties automatically is worth more, in dollars, than most of the underlying case.
segments.tr: - **범위 소송.** 구제책이 비당사자에게 자동으로 적용되는지 여부는 금액 면에서 본래의 사건보다 더 가치가 큽니다.

segments.src: - **The liquidation cutoff rulings.** Courts are being asked whether finality bars claims on entries that liquidated before the decision. This is the single largest variable in the $165 billion estimate.
segments.tr: - **청산 마감일 판결.** 법원은 결정 전 청산된 수입 건에 대한 청구권이 최종성(finality)에 의해 차단되는지 묻고 있습니다. 이는 1,650억 달러 추정치의 가장 큰 변수입니다.

segments.src: - **CBP's processing pace.** Refund throughput, not legal entitlement, now sets the calendar for most companies.
segments.tr: - **CBP의 처리 속도.** 이제 대부분의 기업에게는 법적 권리가 아니라 환급 처리 속도가 일정을 결정합니다.

segments.src: - **New Section 232 proceedings.** Each new product scope narrows the practical benefit of the refund for affected importers.
segments.tr: - **새로운 제232조 절차.** 새로운 제품 범위가 추가될 때마다, 해당 수입업자들의 환급으로 인한 실질적 혜택은 줄어듭니다.

segments.src: - **Congress.** The decision hands tariff-setting back to the legislature by default. Whether Congress legislates new delegated authority, tightens the existing ones, or does nothing will determine what the next version of this looks like.
segments.tr: - **의회.** 이 결정은 기본적으로 관세 설정 권한을 입법부로 되돌렸습니다. 의회가 새로운 위임 권한을 입법화할지, 기존 권한을 강화할지, 아니면 아무것도 하지 않을지가 다음 버전의 상황을 결정할 것입니다.

segments.src: ## A practical checklist for importers
segments.tr: ## 수입업자를 위한 실무 체크리스트

segments.src: If your company imported during the affected period, the useful steps are unglamorous:
segments.tr: 영향을 받은 기간 동안 수입을 진행했다면, 다음과 같은 실무적인 단계들이 유용합니다.

segments.src: 1. **Pull your entry data.** Identify every entry summary in the window and its liquidation status. You cannot claim what you cannot locate.
segments.tr: 1. **수입 데이터 추출.** 해당 기간 내의 모든 수입 신고서와 그 청산 상태를 확인하십시오. 찾지 못하는 것은 청구할 수 없습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Preserve rights on unliquidated entries** through the appropriate protest or post-summary correction channels, with customs counsel, before deadlines pass.
segments.tr: 2. **미청산 수입 건에 대한 권리 보존.** 마감일이 지나기 전에 세관 전문 변호사와 함께 적절한 이의 제기 또는 사후 수정(post-summary correction) 채널을 통해 권리를 보존하십시오.

segments.src: 3. **Separate voided duties from valid ones** line by line. Mixed entries are the most common source of rejected claims.
segments.tr: 3. **무효 관세와 유효 관세를 라인별로 구분.** 혼합된 수입 건은 청구 거부의 가장 흔한 원인입니다.

segments.src: 4. **Read your contracts** for tariff pass-through and adjustment clauses, in both directions, before anyone assumes the refund is theirs.
segments.tr: 4. **계약서 검토.** 누군가 환급금이 자신의 것이라고 가정하기 전에, 양방향의 관세 전가 및 조정 조항을 확인하십시오.

segments.src: 5. **Talk to your auditor early** about recognition timing so the refund does not become a surprise restatement conversation.
segments.tr: 5. **회계사와 조기에 논의.** 인식 시기에 대해 미리 논의하여 환급금이 갑작스러운 재무제표 수정 논의로 이어지지 않게 하십시오.

segments.src: 6. **Model the replacement duties**, not the old ones. Your forward cost curve depends on Section 232 scopes, not on a case you already won.
segments.tr: 6. **대체 관세를 모델링.** 과거의 관세가 아니라 새로운 관세를 모델링하십시오. 향후 비용 곡선은 이미 이긴 소송이 아니라 제232조의 범위에 달려 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The Supreme Court answered a constitutional question cleanly: an emergency-powers statute that never mentions tariffs does not authorize them.
segments.tr: 대법원은 헌법적 질문에 명확하게 답했습니다. 관세를 전혀 언급하지 않는 비상 권한 법령은 관세를 허용하지 않습니다.

segments.src: What it could not do is make an administrative system built for correcting individual entry errors process a nationwide reversal quickly, or prevent the executive branch from rebuilding similar duties through statutes that were always available and are now being used.
segments.tr: 하지만 대법원이 할 수 없었던 것은, 개별 수입 오류를 수정하기 위해 만들어진 행정 시스템이 전국적인 취소를 빠르게 처리하게 만드는 것이나, 행정부가 항상 사용 가능했던 다른 법령을 통해 유사한 관세를 재구축하는 것을 막는 것이었습니다.

segments.src: For 330,000 companies, the ruling converted a cost into a receivable.
segments.tr: 33만 개의 기업에게 이 판결은 비용을 미수금으로 바꾸어 놓았습니다.

segments.src: That is a genuine improvement.
segments.tr: 이는 진정한 개선입니다.

segments.src: It is also a reminder that in trade law, the judgment is the beginning of the process, not the end of it — and that the distance between a court order and a bank deposit is measured in liquidation dates, not in principles.
segments.tr: 또한 무역법에서 판결은 프로세스의 끝이 아니라 시작이라는 점, 그리고 법원 명령과 은행 예금 사이의 거리는 원칙이 아니라 청산일(liquidation dates)로 측정된다는 점을 상기시켜 줍니다.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not legal, tax, or accounting advice.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공을 목적으로 하며, 법률, 세무 또는 회계 자문이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Figures cited are estimates that shift as litigation and refund processing continue.
segments.tr: 인용된 수치는 소송과 환급 처리가 계속됨에 따라 변동되는 추정치입니다.

segments.src: Importers with potential claims should consult licensed customs counsel and their own advisors about their specific entries and deadlines.*
segments.tr: 잠재적 청구권이 있는 수입업자는 자신의 특정 수입 건과 마감일에 대해 공인 세관 변호사 및 자문가와 상의하십시오.*

zh.title: 在最高法院获胜，却仍在等待支票：揭秘无人能领取的 1650 亿美元关税退款

segments.src: There is a peculiar kind of legal victory in which you win everything and receive nothing.
segments.tr: 有一种奇怪的法律胜利，就是你赢得了所有的一切，却什么也没得到。

segments.src: Somewhere around 330,000 American importers are living in it right now.
segments.tr: 目前大约有 33 万名美国进口商正处于这种境地。

segments.src: Six months after the Supreme Court held, 6–3, that the International Emergency Economic Powers Act does not give any president the authority to impose tariffs, the courts have ordered roughly $165 billion in collected duties returned to the companies that paid them.
segments.tr: 在最高法院以 6 比 3 的投票结果裁定《国际紧急经济权力法》（IEEPA）并未赋予任何总统征收关税的权力六个月后，法院已命令将大约 1650 亿美元的已收关税退还给支付这些关税的公司。

segments.src: On paper, that is one of the largest single refund events the U.S.
segments.tr: 从账面上看，这是美国

segments.src: Treasury has ever faced.
segments.tr: 财政部曾面临的最大单次退款事件之一。

segments.src: In practice, most of the businesses entitled to that money have not seen a dollar of it — and a large share of them are still cutting tariff checks every week.
segments.tr: 但在实践中，大多数有权获得这笔资金的企业还没有看到一分钱——而且其中很大一部分企业每周仍在开具关税支票。

segments.src: The gap between the ruling and the refund is not a scandal.
segments.tr: 裁决与退款之间的差距并非丑闻。

segments.src: It is plumbing.
segments.tr: 而是“管道”问题。

segments.src: But the plumbing is worth understanding, because it explains why a landmark constitutional decision has so far changed far less about the cost of importing goods into the United States than the headline suggested.
segments.tr: 但了解这个“管道”很有必要，因为它可以解释为什么一项具有里程碑意义的宪法裁决，在降低美国进口商品成本方面，其效果远低于标题所暗示的程度。

segments.src: ## What the Court actually decided
segments.tr: ## 法院实际裁定的是什么

segments.src: IEEPA, passed in 1977, lets a president declare a national emergency in response to an "unusual and extraordinary threat" originating largely outside the United States, and then take a list of economic actions — among them, the authority to "regulate ...
segments.tr: 1977 年通过的 IEEPA 允许总统在应对主要源自美国境外的“异常且特别的威胁”时宣布国家紧急状态，然后采取一系列经济行动——其中包括“监管……

segments.src: importation."
segments.tr: 进口”的权力。

segments.src: The government's argument rested on those three words.
segments.tr: 政府的论点基于这三个词。

segments.src: If you can regulate importation, the reasoning went, you can condition importation on payment of a duty.
segments.tr: 其逻辑是，如果你能监管进口，那么你就可以将进口以支付关税为条件。

segments.src: Emergencies are unpredictable, and Congress wrote the statute broadly on purpose.
segments.tr: 紧急情况是不可预测的，因此国会故意将该法规制定得较为宽泛。

segments.src: The challengers — a group of small importers and a coalition of states, whose cases were consolidated on the way up — made a structural argument instead.
segments.tr: 挑战者——一组小型进口商和一个州联盟（其案件在上诉过程中被合并）——则提出了结构性论点。

segments.src: The power to lay duties belongs to Congress under Article I.
segments.tr: 根据宪法第一条，征收关税的权力属于国会。

segments.src: IEEPA never uses the words *tariff*, *duty*, or *tax*.
segments.tr: IEEPA 从未使用过 *tariff*（关税）、*duty*（税金）或 *tax*（税）这些词。

segments.src: And in nearly fifty years, across administrations of both parties, no president had ever read the statute that way.
segments.tr: 而且在近五十年里，无论哪个政党的政府，都没有总统这样解读该法规。

segments.src: The majority sided with the challengers, applying the now-familiar principle that Congress does not hide decisions of vast economic and political significance inside vague or ancillary statutory language.
segments.tr: 多数派支持挑战者，采用了现在人们熟悉的原则：国会不会将具有重大经济和政治意义的决定隐藏在模糊或辅助性的法律语言中。

segments.src: The Court noted something telling: when Congress *has* delegated tariff authority, it has done so deliberately and with guardrails — required investigations, agency findings, rate ceilings, sunset clauses.
segments.tr: 法院注意到一个耐人寻味的事实：当国会*确实*授予关税权力时，它是深思熟虑且设有护栏的——要求进行调查、机构调查结果、税率上限、日落条款。

segments.src: IEEPA has none of those.
segments.tr: IEEPA 则没有任何这些措施。

segments.src: The absence of any procedural machinery was treated as evidence that the machinery was never meant to be there.
segments.tr: 缺乏任何程序机制被视为该机制从未打算存在于此的证据。

segments.src: The dissent argued for deference in the field of foreign affairs, and read "regulate importation" as plainly capacious enough to include a tariff.
segments.tr: 异议者主张在外交事务领域应给予尊重，并将“监管进口”解读为足够宽泛，足以涵盖关税。

segments.src: One point gets lost in the coverage: the decision is about *which branch* sets tariffs and *under which statute*.
segments.tr: 在报道中有一个点被忽略了：该裁决是关于*哪个部门*设定关税以及*根据哪个法规*设定。

segments.src: It is not a ruling on whether tariffs are wise policy.
segments.tr: 它并不是关于关税是否是明智政策的裁决。

segments.src: That distinction explains nearly everything that has happened since.
segments.tr: 这一区别解释了之后发生的一切。

segments.src: ## Why winning is not the same as being paid
segments.tr: ## 为什么获胜并不等同于拿到钱

segments.src: Customs refunds do not work like a court-ordered settlement where a check gets mailed.
segments.tr: 海关退款不像法院命令的结算那样直接邮寄支票。

segments.src: They work entry by entry, through a system built for correcting individual paperwork errors, not for unwinding a policy applied to tens of millions of shipments.
segments.tr: 它们是逐笔处理的，通过一个旨在纠正个人文书错误的系统运行，而不是为了撤销一项应用于数千万次货运的政策。

segments.src: **Liquidation is the deadline nobody outside the trade world had heard of.** When goods enter the United States, the importer files an entry summary and deposits estimated duties.
segments.tr: **Liquidation（清算）是贸易圈以外的人从未听过的截止日期。** 当商品进入美国时，进口商提交报关单摘要并缴纳预估关税。

segments.src: Months later, Customs and Border Protection "liquidates" the entry — the final, legally binding computation of what was owed.
segments.tr: 几个月后，海关和边境保护局（CBP）会对该报关单进行“清算”——即对欠款金额的最终且具有法律约束力的计算。

segments.src: Once an entry liquidates and the protest window closes, it is generally final.
segments.tr: 一旦报关单清算且申诉窗口关闭，它通常就是最终结果。

segments.src: Reopening it requires a specific legal hook.
segments.tr: 重新开启它需要特定的法律依据。

segments.src: Many entries from the tariffs' earliest months liquidated long before the case reached the Supreme Court, and a meaningful slice of the theoretical $165 billion sits behind that door.
segments.tr: 许多在关税实施初期产生的报关单在案件提交至最高法院之前就已清算，而理论上的 1650 亿美元中很大一部分就卡在那个门后。

segments.src: **Being right is not the same as being a party.** Court orders run to the parties before the court.
segments.tr: **正确并不等同于成为当事人。** 法院命令适用于法院之前的当事人。

segments.src: Whether relief extends automatically to every importer in the country, or whether each company must file its own protest or suit to claim its share, has been litigated separately — and that secondary fight is where a great deal of the money is currently parked.
segments.tr: 救济是否自动延伸到全国每位进口商，或者每家公司必须提交自己的申诉或诉讼以索取其份额，这已被单独起诉——而这场次要的斗争正是目前大量资金被冻结的地方。

segments.src: Importers who filed protective claims early are in a materially better position than those who waited for the news.
segments.tr: 尽早提交保护性索赔的进口商比那些等待消息的人处于明显更好的位置。

segments.src: **The refund itself is an accounting exercise at enormous scale.** CBP processes tens of millions of entry summaries a year.
segments.tr: **退款本身是一项规模巨大的会计练习。** CBP 每年处理数千万份报关单摘要。

segments.src: Each refund has to be matched to a specific entry, a specific line, a specific tariff classification, and often a specific surety bond.
segments.tr: 每笔退款必须与特定的报关单、特定的行项目、特定的关税分类，且通常与特定的担保债券相匹配。

segments.src: Some entries mixed duties that are now void with duties that remain perfectly valid under other statutes.
segments.tr: 有些报关单将现在失效的关税与根据其他法规仍然完全有效的关税混合在一起。

segments.src: Untangling those lines is manual work, and there is no button that does it.
segments.tr: 理清这些行项目是手动工作，没有一个按钮可以一键完成。

segments.src: **Interest accrues, which softens the wait but complicates the math.** Excess deposits generally carry interest from the date of deposit until refund, at rates Treasury resets quarterly.
segments.tr: **利息在累积，这减轻了等待的痛苦，但使计算复杂化。** 超额缴纳的款项通常从缴纳之日起计算利息直到退款，利率由财政部每季度重新设定。

segments.src: For a company that paid millions in 2025, that is real money — and also a taxable event landing in a different fiscal year than the original expense.
segments.tr: 对于在 2025 年支付了数百万美元的公司来说，这是一笔真实的资金——而且也是一个落在与原始费用不同财政年度的应税事件。

segments.src: **Appeals and remands keep resetting the clock.** Even after a Supreme Court ruling on the core question, the downstream cases about scope, timing, and eligibility continue to move through the Court of International Trade and the Federal Circuit.
segments.tr: **上诉和发回重审不断重启时钟。** 即使在最高法院对核心问题做出裁决后，关于范围、时间和资格的下游案件仍继续在国际贸易法院和联邦巡回法院审理。

segments.src: Every remand adds months.
segments.tr: 每次发回重审都会增加数月时间。

segments.src: ## Who actually gets the money
segments.tr: ## 谁实际上拿到了钱

segments.src: This is the question that produces the most awkward conversations inside companies.
segments.tr: 这个问题在公司内部引发了最尴尬的对话。

segments.src: The refund goes to the **importer of record** — the entity legally on the hook to CBP.
segments.tr: 退款交给 **importer of record（登记进口商）** —— 即在法律上对 CBP 负责的实体。

segments.src: That is often not the party that ultimately bore the cost.
segments.tr: 但这通常不是最终承担成本的一方。

segments.src: A U.S.
segments.tr: 一家支付了关税并提高了价格的美国

segments.src: distributor that paid the duty and raised its prices has already recovered much of it from customers.
segments.tr: 分销商已经从客户那里回收了大部分成本。

segments.src: A retailer that negotiated delivered-duty-paid terms may have pushed the cost onto a foreign supplier.
segments.tr: 一家协商了 DDP（完税后交货）条款的零售商可能已将成本转嫁给外国供应商。

segments.src: Some contracts contain explicit tariff-adjustment clauses that now run in reverse; most do not.
segments.tr: 一些合同包含明确的关税调整条款，现在这些条款反向运行；但大多数合同没有。

segments.src: The result is a wave of quiet commercial negotiation that has nothing to do with the constitutional question: *who, in this supply chain, owns this receivable?* Companies with clean documentation and well-drafted clauses are resolving it in weeks.
segments.tr: 结果是一波与宪法问题无关的安静的商业谈判：*在这个供应链中，谁拥有这笔应收款？* 拥有清晰文件和起草良好的条款的公司在几周内就能解决这个问题。

segments.src: Companies without are discovering that a windfall is only a windfall if you can prove it is yours.
segments.tr: 而没有这些条件的公司则发现，只有当你能证明它是你的时，意外之财才是意外之财。

segments.src: ## The wall that replaced the wall
segments.tr: ## 取代围墙的新墙

segments.src: Here is the part that surprises people who followed only the headline.
segments.tr: 这是让那些只关注标题的人感到惊讶的部分。

segments.src: For many importers, the total duty burden has not fallen much, because the tariffs did not disappear so much as change legal address.
segments.tr: 对于许多进口商来说，总关税负担并没有减轻多少，因为关税并没有消失，而只是改变了法律地址。

segments.src: IEEPA was the fast lane.
segments.tr: IEEPA 是快车道。

segments.src: Everything else is slower, narrower, and procedurally demanding — but it exists, and it has been used.
segments.tr: 其他所有途径都更慢、更窄且程序要求更高——但它们确实存在，并且已被使用。

segments.src: | Authority | What it requires | Practical constraints |
segments.tr: | 权力依据 | 要求条件 | 实际限制 |

segments.src: | **Section 232** (Trade Expansion Act of 1962) | Commerce Department investigation finding that imports threaten national security | Product-by-product; investigations take months; no statutory rate cap |
segments.tr: | **第 232 条** (1962 年《贸易扩张法》) | 商务部调查发现进口威胁国家安全 | 按产品处理；调查需数月时间；无法定税率上限 |

segments.src: | **Section 301** (Trade Act of 1974) | USTR investigation into unfair foreign practices | Country-specific; notice-and-comment; subject to periodic review |
segments.tr: | **第 301 条** (1974 年《贸易法》) | USTR 调查不公平的外国惯例 | 针对特定国家；通知与评论程序； subject to 定期审查 |

segments.src: | **Section 201** (Trade Act of 1974) | ITC finding of serious injury to a domestic industry | Temporary safeguard; must phase down over time |
segments.tr: | **第 201 条** (1974 年《贸易法》) | ITC 认定对国内产业造成严重损害 | 临时保障措施；必须随时间逐步降低 |

segments.src: | **Section 122** (Trade Act of 1974) | Balance-of-payments justification | Capped at 15% and 150 days without congressional action |
segments.tr: | **第 122 条** (1974 年《贸易法》) | 国际收支理由 | 上限为 15% 且在无国会行动的情况下为 150 天 |

segments.src: Section 232 has done most of the work.
segments.tr: 第 232 条承担了大部分工作。

segments.src: Because it is organized around product categories rather than countries, rebuilding coverage means running investigations sector by sector — steel and aluminum derivatives, autos and parts, copper, timber and lumber, pharmaceuticals, semiconductors and downstream electronics.
segments.tr: 因为它围绕产品类别而非国家组织，重新建立覆盖范围意味着要逐个行业运行调查——钢铝衍生品、汽车及零部件、铜、木材和原木、药品、半导体及下游电子产品。

segments.src: Each one is a separate proceeding with its own comment docket and its own effective date.
segments.tr: 每一个都是独立的程序，有自己的评论记录和生效日期。

segments.src: The practical effect for an importer is that a refund for last year's duties can arrive in the same quarter as a new invoice for this year's, on the same product, at a comparable rate, under a different statute.
segments.tr: 对于进口商来说，实际效果是去年的关税退款可能在同一季度收到，而同一产品、类似税率、但根据不同法规开出的今年新发票也同时到达。

segments.src: The money is real.
segments.tr: 钱是真的。

segments.src: The relief is not.
segments.tr: 但救济不是。

segments.src: ## What it means for the books
segments.tr: ## 对账目意味着什么

segments.src: Accountants have been unusually vocal about this one.
segments.tr: 会计师们对此异常关注。

segments.src: Under U.S.
segments.tr: 根据美国

segments.src: GAAP, gain contingencies generally are not recognized until realized or realizable — so a company cannot simply book its expected refund as an asset because it read a favorable opinion.
segments.tr: GAAP（通用会计准则），收益或有事项通常在实现或可实现时才予以确认——因此，公司不能仅仅因为阅读了一份有利的意见书就将预期退款记录为资产。

segments.src: The original tariffs were typically expensed through cost of goods sold or capitalized into inventory.
segments.tr: 原始关税通常通过销货成本计入费用或资本化到库存中。

segments.src: The refunds, when they land, tend to arrive as a lump in a later period, distorting margins in a quarter that had nothing to do with the shipments in question.
segments.tr: 退款在到账时，往往是以一笔总额在后期期间到账，从而扭曲了与涉事货运无关的某个季度的利润率。

segments.src: That timing mismatch is why some importers with large confirmed claims still look, on paper, like they are absorbing tariff costs.
segments.tr: 这种时间上的不匹配，就是为什么一些拥有大量确认索赔的进口商在账面上看起来仍然在承担关税成本。

segments.src: They are — until the money moves.
segments.tr: 他们确实在承担——直到资金到账。

segments.src: ## What it means for prices
segments.tr: ## 对价格意味着什么

segments.src: Prices are famously sticky downward.
segments.tr: 价格在下调时具有著名的“粘性”。

segments.src: Costs that got passed to consumers over two years do not reverse on the day a court rules, particularly when replacement duties are landing in the same categories.
segments.tr: 在两年内转嫁给消费者的成本，不会在法院裁决当天就反转，特别是当替代性关税落在相同类别时。

segments.src: Where relief has shown up fastest is in goods that fell outside every Section 232 product scope — certain consumer categories, some apparel and household goods, various inputs with no plausible national-security framing.
segments.tr: 救济出现最快的地方是那些不属于任何第 232 条产品范围的商品——某些消费类产品、部分服装和家居用品，以及各种没有合理国家安全框架的投入品。

segments.src: Where it has shown up least is anywhere touching metals, vehicles, electronics, or pharmaceuticals.
segments.tr: 救济最少的地方是任何涉及金属、车辆、电子产品或药品的领域。

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 接下来的关注点

segments.src: - **The scope litigation.** Whether relief reaches non-parties automatically is worth more, in dollars, than most of the underlying case.
segments.tr: - **范围诉讼。** 救济是否自动延伸至非当事人，其涉及的金额比大多数基础案件还要多。

segments.src: - **The liquidation cutoff rulings.** Courts are being asked whether finality bars claims on entries that liquidated before the decision. This is the single largest variable in the $165 billion estimate.
segments.tr: - **清算截止日期裁决。** 法院被要求裁定最终性是否禁止对在裁决前已清算的报关单提出索赔。这是 1650 亿美元预估值中最大的单一变量。

segments.src: - **CBP's processing pace.** Refund throughput, not legal entitlement, now sets the calendar for most companies.
segments.tr: - **CBP 的处理速度。** 退款的处理吞吐量，而非法律权利，现在决定了大多数公司的时间表。

segments.src: - **New Section 232 proceedings.** Each new product scope narrows the practical benefit of the refund for affected importers.
segments.tr: - **新的第 232 条程序。** 每个新的产品范围都削弱了受影响进口商获得退款的实际利益。

segments.src: - **Congress.** The decision hands tariff-setting back to the legislature by default. Whether Congress legislates new delegated authority, tightens the existing ones, or does nothing will determine what the next version of this looks like.
segments.tr: - **国会。** 该裁决默认将设定关税的权力交还给了立法机构。国会是否立法授予新的委托权力、收紧现有权力或不采取任何行动，将决定下一版本的形式如何。

segments.src: ## A practical checklist for importers
segments.tr: ## 进口商实用清单

segments.src: If your company imported during the affected period, the useful steps are unglamorous:
segments.tr: 如果您的公司在受影响期间进行了进口，以下实用步骤虽然枯燥但很有必要：

segments.src: 1. **Pull your entry data.** Identify every entry summary in the window and its liquidation status. You cannot claim what you cannot locate.
segments.tr: 1. **提取报关数据。** 识别窗口期内的每份报关单摘要及其清算状态。你无法索赔你找不到的东西。

segments.src: 2. **Preserve rights on unliquidated entries** through the appropriate protest or post-summary correction channels, with customs counsel, before deadlines pass.
segments.tr: 2. **在截止日期前，通过适当的申诉或摘要后修正渠道，在海关律师的指导下，保留未清算报关单的权利。**

segments.src: 3. **Separate voided duties from valid ones** line by line. Mixed entries are the most common source of rejected claims.
segments.tr: 3. **逐行区分失效关税与有效关税。** 混合报关单是索赔被拒绝最常见的原因。

segments.src: 4. **Read your contracts** for tariff pass-through and adjustment clauses, in both directions, before anyone assumes the refund is theirs.
segments.tr: 4. **阅读您的合同**，查看关税转嫁和调整条款（双向），在任何人假设退款属于他们之前。

segments.src: 5. **Talk to your auditor early** about recognition timing so the refund does not become a surprise restatement conversation.
segments.tr: 5. **尽早与审计师沟通** 确认时间，以免退款变成一次意外的财务重述对话。

segments.src: 6. **Model the replacement duties**, not the old ones. Your forward cost curve depends on Section 232 scopes, not on a case you already won.
segments.tr: 6. **对替代性关税进行建模**，而非旧关税。您的前瞻性成本曲线取决于第 232 条的范围，而非一个您已经获胜的案件。

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: The Supreme Court answered a constitutional question cleanly: an emergency-powers statute that never mentions tariffs does not authorize them.
segments.tr: 最高法院清晰地回答了一个宪法问题：一个从未提及关税的紧急权力法规并不授权征收关税。

segments.src: What it could not do is make an administrative system built for correcting individual entry errors process a nationwide reversal quickly, or prevent the executive branch from rebuilding similar duties through statutes that were always available and are now being used.
segments.tr: 但它无法让一个旨在纠正个人报关错误的行政系统快速处理全国性的反转，也无法阻止行政部门通过一直可用且现在被使用的法规重新建立类似的关税。

segments.src: For 330,000 companies, the ruling converted a cost into a receivable.
segments.tr: 对于 33 万家公司来说，该裁决将一项成本转变为一项应收款。

segments.src: That is a genuine improvement.
segments.tr: 这是一个真正的进步。

segments.src: It is also a reminder that in trade law, the judgment is the beginning of the process, not the end of it — and that the distance between a court order and a bank deposit is measured in liquidation dates, not in principles.
segments.tr: 但它也提醒我们，在贸易法中，判决是过程的开始，而非结束——而且法院命令与银行存款之间的距离是由清算日期决定的，而非原则。

segments.src: *This article is general information, not legal, tax, or accounting advice.
segments.tr: *本文章提供一般信息，不构成法律、税务或会计建议。

segments.src: Figures cited are estimates that shift as litigation and refund processing continue.
segments.tr: 文中引用的数字是估计值，将随着诉讼和退款处理的继续而变化。

segments.src: Importers with potential claims should consult licensed customs counsel and their own advisors about their specific entries and deadlines.*
segments.tr: 有潜在索赔的进口商应就其具体报关单和截止日期咨询执业海关律师及其顾问。*

hi.title: सुप्रीम कोर्ट में जीत, फिर भी चेक का इंतज़ार: $165 बिलियन के टैरिफ रिफंड के अंदर की कहानी जिसे कोई वसूल नहीं कर पा रहा

segments.src: There is a peculiar kind of legal victory in which you win everything and receive nothing.
segments.tr: एक अजीब तरह की कानूनी जीत होती है जिसमें आप सब कुछ जीतते हैं लेकिन आपको कुछ नहीं मिलता।

segments.src: Somewhere around 330,000 American importers are living in it right now.
segments.tr: लगभग 330,000 अमेरिकी आयातक अभी इसी स्थिति में जी रहे हैं।

segments.src: Six months after the Supreme Court held, 6–3, that the International Emergency Economic Powers Act does not give any president the authority to impose tariffs, the courts have ordered roughly $165 billion in collected duties returned to the companies that paid them.
segments.tr: सुप्रीम कोर्ट द्वारा 6-3 के बहुमत से यह फैसला सुनाए जाने के छह महीने बाद कि इंटरनेशनल इमरजेंसी इकोनॉमिक पावर्स एक्ट (IEEPA) किसी भी राष्ट्रपति को टैरिफ लगाने का अधिकार नहीं देता है, अदालतों ने लगभग $165 बिलियन के वसूले गए शुल्कों को उन कंपनियों को वापस करने का आदेश दिया है जिन्होंने उनका भुगतान किया था।

segments.src: On paper, that is one of the largest single refund events the U.S.
segments.tr: कागजों पर, यह अमेरिका के सबसे बड़े एकल रिफंड आयोजनों में से एक है जिसका सामना

segments.src: Treasury has ever faced.
segments.tr: ट्रेजरी ने कभी किया है।

segments.src: In practice, most of the businesses entitled to that money have not seen a dollar of it — and a large share of them are still cutting tariff checks every week.
segments.tr: व्यवहार में, उस पैसे का हकदार अधिकांश व्यवसायों ने इसका एक डॉलर भी नहीं देखा है — और उनमें से एक बड़ा हिस्सा अभी भी हर हफ्ते टैरिफ चेक काट रहा है।

segments.src: The gap between the ruling and the refund is not a scandal.
segments.tr: फैसले और रिफंड के बीच का यह अंतर कोई घोटाला नहीं है।

segments.src: It is plumbing.
segments.tr: यह सिस्टम की आंतरिक कार्यप्रणाली (प्लंबिंग) है।

segments.src: But the plumbing is worth understanding, because it explains why a landmark constitutional decision has so far changed far less about the cost of importing goods into the United States than the headline suggested.
segments.tr: लेकिन इस कार्यप्रणाली को समझना ज़रूरी है, क्योंकि यह बताता है कि क्यों एक ऐतिहासिक संवैधानिक निर्णय ने अब तक आयातित वस्तुओं की लागत में उतनी कमी नहीं की है जितनी कि हेडलाइन ने संकेत दिया था।

segments.src: ## What the Court actually decided
segments.tr: ## कोर्ट ने वास्तव में क्या फैसला सुनाया

segments.src: IEEPA, passed in 1977, lets a president declare a national emergency in response to an "unusual and extraordinary threat" originating largely outside the United States, and then take a list of economic actions — among them, the authority to "regulate ...
segments.tr: 1977 में पारित IEEPA, राष्ट्रपति को मुख्य रूप से संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका के बाहर से उत्पन्न होने वाले "असामान्य और असाधारण खतरे" के जवाब में राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल घोषित करने की अनुमति देता है, और फिर आर्थिक कार्रवाइयों की एक सूची लेने देता है — जिनमें "विनियमित करने...

segments.src: importation."
segments.tr: आयात" का अधिकार शामिल है।

segments.src: The government's argument rested on those three words.
segments.tr: सरकार का तर्क उन तीन शब्दों पर आधारित था।

segments.src: If you can regulate importation, the reasoning went, you can condition importation on payment of a duty.
segments.tr: तर्क यह था कि यदि आप आयात को विनियमित कर सकते हैं, तो आप आयात को शुल्क के भुगतान की शर्त पर आधारित कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: Emergencies are unpredictable, and Congress wrote the statute broadly on purpose.
segments.tr: आपातकाल अप्रत्याशित होते हैं, और कांग्रेस ने जानबूझकर इस कानून को व्यापक रूप से लिखा था।

segments.src: The challengers — a group of small importers and a coalition of states, whose cases were consolidated on the way up — made a structural argument instead.
segments.tr: चुनौती देने वालों — छोटे आयातकों के एक समूह और राज्यों के एक गठबंधन, जिनके मामलों को ऊपर ले जाते समय एकीकृत किया गया था — ने इसके बजाय एक संरचनात्मक तर्क दिया।

segments.src: The power to lay duties belongs to Congress under Article I.
segments.tr: अनुच्छेद I के तहत शुल्क लगाने की शक्ति कांग्रेस के पास है।

segments.src: IEEPA never uses the words *tariff*, *duty*, or *tax*.
segments.tr: IEEPA में कभी भी *टैरिफ*, *ड्यूटी* या *टैक्स* शब्दों का उपयोग नहीं किया गया है।

segments.src: And in nearly fifty years, across administrations of both parties, no president had ever read the statute that way.
segments.tr: और लगभग पचास वर्षों में, दोनों पार्टियों के प्रशासनों में, किसी भी राष्ट्रपति ने कानून को इस तरह से नहीं पढ़ा था।

segments.src: The majority sided with the challengers, applying the now-familiar principle that Congress does not hide decisions of vast economic and political significance inside vague or ancillary statutory language.
segments.tr: बहुमत ने चुनौती देने वालों का साथ दिया, और उस अब-परिचित सिद्धांत को लागू किया कि कांग्रेस विशाल आर्थिक और राजनीतिक महत्व के निर्णयों को अस्पष्ट या सहायक वैधानिक भाषा के अंदर नहीं छिपाती है।

segments.src: The Court noted something telling: when Congress *has* delegated tariff authority, it has done so deliberately and with guardrails — required investigations, agency findings, rate ceilings, sunset clauses.
segments.tr: कोर्ट ने एक महत्वपूर्ण बात नोट की: जब कांग्रेस ने टैरिफ अधिकार सौंपे हैं, तो उसने ऐसा जानबूझकर और सुरक्षा उपायों के साथ किया है — जैसे आवश्यक जांच, एजेंसी के निष्कर्ष, दर की सीमाएं, सनसेट क्लॉज।

segments.src: IEEPA has none of those.
segments.tr: IEEPA में इनमें से कोई भी नहीं है।

segments.src: The absence of any procedural machinery was treated as evidence that the machinery was never meant to be there.
segments.tr: किसी भी प्रक्रियात्मक मशीनरी की अनुपस्थिति को इस बात के प्रमाण के रूप में माना गया कि मशीनरी का वहां होने का इरादा कभी था ही नहीं।

segments.src: The dissent argued for deference in the field of foreign affairs, and read "regulate importation" as plainly capacious enough to include a tariff.
segments.tr: असहमति जताने वालों ने विदेश मामलों के क्षेत्र में सम्मान का तर्क दिया, और "आयात विनियमित करें" को स्पष्ट रूप से इतना व्यापक माना कि इसमें टैरिफ शामिल हो सके।

segments.src: One point gets lost in the coverage: the decision is about *which branch* sets tariffs and *under which statute*.
segments.tr: कवरेज में एक बिंदु छूट जाता है: निर्णय इस बारे में है कि *कौन सी शाखा* टैरिफ निर्धारित करती है और *किस कानून के तहत*।

segments.src: It is not a ruling on whether tariffs are wise policy.
segments.tr: यह इस बात पर फैसला नहीं है कि टैरिफ एक समझदारी भरी नीति है या नहीं।

segments.src: That distinction explains nearly everything that has happened since.
segments.tr: यह अंतर उसके बाद हुई लगभग हर चीज़ की व्याख्या करता है।

segments.src: ## Why winning is not the same as being paid
segments.tr: ## जीतना, भुगतान पाने के समान क्यों नहीं है

segments.src: Customs refunds do not work like a court-ordered settlement where a check gets mailed.
segments.tr: सीमा शुल्क रिफंड किसी कोर्ट-आदेशित समझौते की तरह काम नहीं करते जहाँ एक चेक डाक से भेजा जाता है।

segments.src: They work entry by entry, through a system built for correcting individual paperwork errors, not for unwinding a policy applied to tens of millions of shipments.
segments.tr: वे प्रविष्टि दर प्रविष्टि (entry by entry) काम करते हैं, एक ऐसे सिस्टम के माध्यम से जो व्यक्तिगत कागजी गलतियों को सुधारने के लिए बनाया गया है, न कि करोड़ों शिपमेंट पर लागू एक नीति को उलझाने के लिए।

segments.src: **Liquidation is the deadline nobody outside the trade world had heard of.** When goods enter the United States, the importer files an entry summary and deposits estimated duties.
segments.tr: **लिक्विडेशन वह समय सीमा है जिसके बारे में व्यापार जगत के बाहर किसी ने नहीं सुना था।** जब सामान संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में प्रवेश करता है, तो आयातक एक प्रविष्टि सारांश (entry summary) दाखिल करता है और अनुमानित शुल्क जमा करता है।

segments.src: Months later, Customs and Border Protection "liquidates" the entry — the final, legally binding computation of what was owed.
segments.tr: महीनों बाद, सीमा शुल्क और सीमा सुरक्षा (CBP) प्रविष्टि को "लिक्विडेट" करती है — जो इस बात की अंतिम, कानूनी रूप से बाध्यकारी गणना है कि कितना बकाया था।

segments.src: Once an entry liquidates and the protest window closes, it is generally final.
segments.tr: एक बार जब प्रविष्टि लिक्विडेट हो जाती है और विरोध की खिड़की बंद हो जाती है, तो यह आम तौर पर अंतिम होती है।

segments.src: Reopening it requires a specific legal hook.
segments.tr: इसे फिर से खोलने के लिए एक विशिष्ट कानूनी आधार की आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: Many entries from the tariffs' earliest months liquidated long before the case reached the Supreme Court, and a meaningful slice of the theoretical $165 billion sits behind that door.
segments.tr: टैरिफ के शुरुआती महीनों की कई प्रविष्टियाँ मामला सुप्रीम कोर्ट पहुँचने से बहुत पहले लिक्विडेट हो गई थीं, और सैद्धांतिक $165 बिलियन का एक बड़ा हिस्सा उसी बंद दरवाजे के पीछे है।

segments.src: **Being right is not the same as being a party.** Court orders run to the parties before the court.
segments.tr: **सही होना, एक पक्ष होना समान नहीं है।** कोर्ट के आदेश उन पक्षों के लिए होते हैं जो कोर्ट के सामने होते हैं।

segments.src: Whether relief extends automatically to every importer in the country, or whether each company must file its own protest or suit to claim its share, has been litigated separately — and that secondary fight is where a great deal of the money is currently parked.
segments.tr: क्या राहत स्वचालित रूप से देश के हर आयातक तक पहुँचती है, या क्या प्रत्येक कंपनी को अपना हिस्सा दावा करने के लिए अपनी अलग विरोध या मुकदमा दाखिल करना होगा, इस पर अलग से मुकदमा लड़ा गया है — और इसी माध्यमिक लड़ाई में वर्तमान में बहुत सारा पैसा अटका हुआ है।

segments.src: Importers who filed protective claims early are in a materially better position than those who waited for the news.
segments.tr: जिन आयातकों ने जल्दी सुरक्षात्मक दावे दाखिल किए, वे उन लोगों की तुलना में काफी बेहतर स्थिति में हैं जिन्होंने खबर का इंतज़ार किया।

segments.src: **The refund itself is an accounting exercise at enormous scale.** CBP processes tens of millions of entry summaries a year.
segments.tr: **रिफंड अपने आप में एक विशाल स्तर का लेखांकन अभ्यास है।** CBP साल में करोड़ों प्रविष्टि सारांशों को प्रोसेस करता है।

segments.src: Each refund has to be matched to a specific entry, a specific line, a specific tariff classification, and often a specific surety bond.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक रिफंड को एक विशिष्ट प्रविष्टि, एक विशिष्ट लाइन, एक विशिष्ट टैरिफ वर्गीकरण, और अक्सर एक विशिष्ट श्योरिटी बॉन्ड से मिलाना होता है।

segments.src: Some entries mixed duties that are now void with duties that remain perfectly valid under other statutes.
segments.tr: कुछ प्रविष्टियों में उन शुल्कों को मिलाया गया था जो अब शून्य हो गए हैं, उन शुल्कों के साथ जो अन्य कानूनों के तहत पूरी तरह से मान्य रहते हैं।

segments.src: Untangling those lines is manual work, and there is no button that does it.
segments.tr: उन लाइनों को सुलझाना एक मैनुअल काम है, और ऐसा कोई बटन नहीं है जो इसे कर सके।

segments.src: **Interest accrues, which softens the wait but complicates the math.** Excess deposits generally carry interest from the date of deposit until refund, at rates Treasury resets quarterly.
segments.tr: **ब्याज बढ़ता है, जो इंतज़ार को आसान बनाता है लेकिन गणित को जटिल करता है।** अतिरिक्त जमा राशि पर आम तौर पर जमा की तारीख से रिफंड तक ब्याज मिलता है, जिसकी दरें ट्रेजरी त्रैमासिक रूप से निर्धारित करती है।

segments.src: For a company that paid millions in 2025, that is real money — and also a taxable event landing in a different fiscal year than the original expense.
segments.tr: 2025 में लाखों का भुगतान करने वाली कंपनी के लिए, यह वास्तविक पैसा है — और यह एक कर योग्य घटना भी है जो मूल व्यय से अलग वित्तीय वर्ष में आती है।

segments.src: **Appeals and remands keep resetting the clock.** Even after a Supreme Court ruling on the core question, the downstream cases about scope, timing, and eligibility continue to move through the Court of International Trade and the Federal Circuit.
segments.tr: **अपील और रिमांड घड़ी को रीसेट करते रहते हैं।** मुख्य प्रश्न पर सुप्रीम कोर्ट के फैसले के बाद भी, दायरे, समय और पात्रता के बारे में डाउनस्ट्रीम मामले इंटरनेशनल ट्रेड कोर्ट और फेडरल सर्किट के माध्यम से चलते रहते हैं।

segments.src: Every remand adds months.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक रिमांड महीनों जोड़ देता है।

segments.src: ## Who actually gets the money
segments.tr: ## वास्तव में पैसा किसे मिलता है

segments.src: This is the question that produces the most awkward conversations inside companies.
segments.tr: यह वह प्रश्न है जो कंपनियों के अंदर सबसे अजीब बातचीत पैदा करता है।

segments.src: The refund goes to the **importer of record** — the entity legally on the hook to CBP.
segments.tr: रिफंड **रिकॉर्ड के आयातक (importer of record)** को जाता है — वह इकाई जो कानूनी रूप से CBP के प्रति जवाबदेह है।

segments.src: That is often not the party that ultimately bore the cost.
segments.tr: अक्सर वह पक्ष नहीं होता जिसने अंततः लागत वहन की।

segments.src: A U.S.
segments.tr: एक अमेरिकी

segments.src: distributor that paid the duty and raised its prices has already recovered much of it from customers.
segments.tr: वितरक जिसने शुल्क का भुगतान किया और अपनी कीमतें बढ़ाईं, उसने पहले ही ग्राहकों से इसका काफी हिस्सा वसूल कर लिया है।

segments.src: A retailer that negotiated delivered-duty-paid terms may have pushed the cost onto a foreign supplier.
segments.tr: एक रिटेलर जिसने 'डिलीवर्ड-ड्यूटी-पेड' शर्तों पर बातचीत की, उसने लागत को विदेशी आपूर्तिकर्ता पर डाल दिया होगा।

segments.src: Some contracts contain explicit tariff-adjustment clauses that now run in reverse; most do not.
segments.tr: कुछ अनुबंधों में स्पष्ट टैरिफ-समायोजन क्लॉज होते हैं जो अब विपरीत दिशा में काम करते हैं; अधिकांश में नहीं होते।

segments.src: The result is a wave of quiet commercial negotiation that has nothing to do with the constitutional question: *who, in this supply chain, owns this receivable?* Companies with clean documentation and well-drafted clauses are resolving it in weeks.
segments.tr: इसका परिणाम एक शांत वाणिज्यिक बातचीत की लहर है जिसका संवैधानिक प्रश्न से कोई लेना-देना नहीं है: *इस आपूर्ति श्रृंखला में, इस प्राप्य (receivable) का मालिक कौन है?* जिन कंपनियों के पास स्पष्ट दस्तावेज़ीकरण और अच्छी तरह से लिखे गए क्लॉज हैं, वे इसे हफ्तों में सुलझा रहे हैं।

segments.src: Companies without are discovering that a windfall is only a windfall if you can prove it is yours.
segments.tr: जिन कंपनियों के पास ये नहीं हैं, वे यह खोज रहे हैं कि एक अप्रत्याशित लाभ (windfall) केवल तभी लाभ होता है जब आप साबित कर सकें कि यह आपका है।

segments.src: ## The wall that replaced the wall
segments.tr: ## दीवार की जगह दूसरी दीवार

segments.src: Here is the part that surprises people who followed only the headline.
segments.tr: यह वह हिस्सा है जो उन लोगों को हैरान करता है जिन्होंने केवल हेडलाइन पढ़ी।

segments.src: For many importers, the total duty burden has not fallen much, because the tariffs did not disappear so much as change legal address.
segments.tr: कई आयातकों के लिए, कुल शुल्क बोझ बहुत कम नहीं हुआ है, क्योंकि टैरिफ गायब नहीं हुए बल्कि उनका कानूनी पता बदल गया।

segments.src: IEEPA was the fast lane.
segments.tr: IEEPA तेज़ रास्ता था।

segments.src: Everything else is slower, narrower, and procedurally demanding — but it exists, and it has been used.
segments.tr: बाकी सब धीमा, संकरा और प्रक्रियात्मक रूप से कठिन है — लेकिन यह मौजूद है, और इसका उपयोग किया गया है।

segments.src: | Authority | What it requires | Practical constraints |
segments.tr: | अधिकार | इसकी आवश्यकता | व्यावहारिक बाधाएं |

segments.src: | **Section 232** (Trade Expansion Act of 1962) | Commerce Department investigation finding that imports threaten national security | Product-by-product; investigations take months; no statutory rate cap |
segments.tr: | **धारा 232** (1962 का ट्रेड एक्सपेंशन एक्ट) | वाणिज्य विभाग की जांच जिसमें पाया गया कि आयात राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा के लिए खतरा है | उत्पाद-दर-उत्पाद; जांच में महीनों लगते हैं; कोई वैधानिक दर सीमा नहीं |

segments.src: | **Section 301** (Trade Act of 1974) | USTR investigation into unfair foreign practices | Country-specific; notice-and-comment; subject to periodic review |
segments.tr: | **धारा 301** (1974 का ट्रेड एक्ट) | अनुचित विदेशी प्रथाओं में USTR की जांच | देश-विशिष्ट; नोटिस-और-कमेंट; समय-समय पर समीक्षा के अधीन |

segments.src: | **Section 201** (Trade Act of 1974) | ITC finding of serious injury to a domestic industry | Temporary safeguard; must phase down over time |
segments.tr: | **धारा 201** (1974 का ट्रेड एक्ट) | घरेलू उद्योग को गंभीर चोट पहुँचाने का ITC का निष्कर्ष | अस्थायी सुरक्षा; समय के साथ कम होना चाहिए |

segments.src: | **Section 122** (Trade Act of 1974) | Balance-of-payments justification | Capped at 15% and 150 days without congressional action |
segments.tr: | **धारा 122** (1974 का ट्रेड एक्ट) | भुगतान संतुलन का औचित्य | कांग्रेस की कार्रवाई के बिना 15% और 150 दिनों तक सीमित |

segments.src: Section 232 has done most of the work.
segments.tr: धारा 232 ने अधिकांश काम किया है।

segments.src: Because it is organized around product categories rather than countries, rebuilding coverage means running investigations sector by sector — steel and aluminum derivatives, autos and parts, copper, timber and lumber, pharmaceuticals, semiconductors and downstream electronics.
segments.tr: क्योंकि यह देशों के बजाय उत्पाद श्रेणियों के इर्द-गिर्द व्यवस्थित है, कवरेज को फिर से बनाने का मतलब है क्षेत्र-दर-क्षेत्र जांच चलाना — स्टील और एल्युमीनियम डेरिवेटिव, ऑटो और पार्ट्स, कॉपर, टिम्बर और लम्बर, फार्मास्यूटिकल्स, सेमीकंडक्टर्स और डाउनस्ट्रीम इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स।

segments.src: Each one is a separate proceeding with its own comment docket and its own effective date.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक एक अलग कार्यवाही है जिसमें अपना स्वयं का कमेंट डॉकेट और अपनी प्रभावी तिथि होती है।

segments.src: The practical effect for an importer is that a refund for last year's duties can arrive in the same quarter as a new invoice for this year's, on the same product, at a comparable rate, under a different statute.
segments.tr: एक आयातक के लिए व्यावहारिक प्रभाव यह है कि पिछले साल के शुल्कों का रिफंड उसी तिमाही में आ सकता है जब इस साल के लिए एक नया चालान आता है, उसी उत्पाद पर, एक तुलनीय दर पर, लेकिन एक अलग कानून के तहत।

segments.src: The money is real.
segments.tr: पैसा वास्तविक है।

segments.src: The relief is not.
segments.tr: राहत नहीं।

segments.src: ## What it means for the books
segments.tr: ## खातों (books) के लिए इसका क्या मतलब है

segments.src: Accountants have been unusually vocal about this one.
segments.tr: लेखाकारों ने इस बारे में असामान्य रूप से मुखर राय दी है।

segments.src: Under U.S.
segments.tr: अमेरिकी

segments.src: GAAP, gain contingencies generally are not recognized until realized or realizable — so a company cannot simply book its expected refund as an asset because it read a favorable opinion.
segments.tr: GAAP के तहत, लाभ आकस्मिकताओं (gain contingencies) को आम तौर पर तब तक मान्यता नहीं दी जाती जब तक कि वे प्राप्त न हो जाएं या प्राप्त करने योग्य न हों — इसलिए एक कंपनी केवल एक अनुकूल राय पढ़ने के कारण अपने अपेक्षित रिफंड को संपत्ति के रूप में दर्ज नहीं कर सकती।

segments.src: The original tariffs were typically expensed through cost of goods sold or capitalized into inventory.
segments.tr: मूल टैरिफ आमतौर पर बेचे गए माल की लागत (cost of goods sold) के माध्यम से खर्च किए गए थे या इन्वेंट्री में पूंजीकृत किए गए थे।

segments.src: The refunds, when they land, tend to arrive as a lump in a later period, distorting margins in a quarter that had nothing to do with the shipments in question.
segments.tr: रिफंड, जब वे आते हैं, तो बाद की अवधि में एकमुश्त राशि के रूप में आते हैं, जिससे उस तिमाही के मार्जिन विकृत हो जाते हैं जिसका उन शिपमेंट से कोई लेना-देना नहीं था।

segments.src: That timing mismatch is why some importers with large confirmed claims still look, on paper, like they are absorbing tariff costs.
segments.tr: समय का यह बेमेल होना ही कारण है कि बड़े पुष्ट दावों वाले कुछ आयातक अभी भी कागजों पर ऐसे दिखते हैं जैसे वे टैरिफ लागतों को खुद वहन कर रहे हों।

segments.src: They are — until the money moves.
segments.tr: वे ऐसा कर रहे हैं — जब तक कि पैसा नहीं आता।

segments.src: ## What it means for prices
segments.tr: ## कीमतों के लिए इसका क्या मतलब है

segments.src: Prices are famously sticky downward.
segments.tr: कीमतें नीचे की ओर जाने में प्रसिद्ध रूप से धीमी होती हैं।

segments.src: Costs that got passed to consumers over two years do not reverse on the day a court rules, particularly when replacement duties are landing in the same categories.
segments.tr: लागतें जो दो साल में उपभोक्ताओं तक पहुँचीं, वे उस दिन वापस नहीं आतीं जिस दिन कोर्ट फैसला सुनाता है, खासकर जब उसी श्रेणी में प्रतिस्थापन शुल्क लग रहे हों।

segments.src: Where relief has shown up fastest is in goods that fell outside every Section 232 product scope — certain consumer categories, some apparel and household goods, various inputs with no plausible national-security framing.
segments.tr: जहाँ राहत सबसे तेज़ी से दिखी है, वह उन वस्तुओं में है जो धारा 232 के उत्पाद दायरे से बाहर थीं — कुछ उपभोक्ता श्रेणियां, कुछ कपड़े और घरेलू सामान, विभिन्न इनपुट जिनके लिए राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा का कोई तर्कसंगत ढांचा नहीं था।

segments.src: Where it has shown up least is anywhere touching metals, vehicles, electronics, or pharmaceuticals.
segments.tr: जहाँ यह सबसे कम दिखी है, वह धातुओं, वाहनों, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स या फार्मास्यूटिकल्स से जुड़ी किसी भी चीज़ में है।

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या देखना है

segments.src: - **The scope litigation.** Whether relief reaches non-parties automatically is worth more, in dollars, than most of the underlying case.
segments.tr: - **दायरे का मुकदमा।** क्या राहत स्वचालित रूप से गैर-पक्षों तक पहुँचती है, यह मूल मामले से अधिक डॉलर मूल्य का है।

segments.src: - **The liquidation cutoff rulings.** Courts are being asked whether finality bars claims on entries that liquidated before the decision. This is the single largest variable in the $165 billion estimate.
segments.tr: - **लिक्विडेशन कटऑफ फैसले।** अदालतों से पूछा जा रहा है कि क्या अंतिमता उन प्रविष्टियों के दावों को रोकती है जो फैसले से पहले लिक्विडेट हो गई थीं। यह $165 बिलियन के अनुमान में सबसे बड़ा चर (variable) है।

segments.src: - **CBP's processing pace.** Refund throughput, not legal entitlement, now sets the calendar for most companies.
segments.tr: - **CBP की प्रोसेसिंग गति।** रिफंड थ्रूपुट, न कि कानूनी पात्रता, अब अधिकांश कंपनियों के लिए कैलेंडर निर्धारित करता है।

segments.src: - **New Section 232 proceedings.** Each new product scope narrows the practical benefit of the refund for affected importers.
segments.tr: - **नई धारा 232 कार्यवाहियां।** प्रत्येक नया उत्पाद दायरा प्रभावित आयातकों के लिए रिफंड के व्यावहारिक लाभ को कम करता है।

segments.src: - **Congress.** The decision hands tariff-setting back to the legislature by default. Whether Congress legislates new delegated authority, tightens the existing ones, or does nothing will determine what the next version of this looks like.
segments.tr: - **कांग्रेस।** यह निर्णय डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से टैरिफ निर्धारित करने का अधिकार वापस विधायिका को सौंपता है। क्या कांग्रेस नए प्रत्यायोजित अधिकार कानून बनाती है, मौजूदा अधिकारों को कड़ा करती है, या कुछ नहीं करती, इससे यह निर्धारित होगा कि इसका अगला संस्करण कैसा दिखेगा।

segments.src: ## A practical checklist for importers
segments.tr: ## आयातकों के लिए एक व्यावहारिक चेकलिस्ट

segments.src: If your company imported during the affected period, the useful steps are unglamorous:
segments.tr: यदि आपकी कंपनी ने प्रभावित अवधि के दौरान आयात किया, तो उपयोगी कदम उबाऊ हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Pull your entry data.** Identify every entry summary in the window and its liquidation status. You cannot claim what you cannot locate.
segments.tr: 1. **अपना प्रविष्टि डेटा निकालें।** उस अवधि के दौरान हर प्रविष्टि सारांश और उसकी लिक्विडेशन स्थिति की पहचान करें। आप उस चीज़ का दावा नहीं कर सकते जिसे आप खोज नहीं सकते।

segments.src: 2. **Preserve rights on unliquidated entries** through the appropriate protest or post-summary correction channels, with customs counsel, before deadlines pass.
segments.tr: 2. **बिना लिक्विडेट हुई प्रविष्टियों पर अधिकारों को सुरक्षित रखें** उचित विरोध या पोस्ट-समरी सुधार चैनलों के माध्यम से, सीमा शुल्क वकील के साथ, समय सीमा समाप्त होने से पहले।

segments.src: 3. **Separate voided duties from valid ones** line by line. Mixed entries are the most common source of rejected claims.
segments.tr: 3. **शून्य किए गए शुल्कों को मान्य शुल्कों से अलग करें** लाइन दर लाइन। मिश्रित प्रविष्टियाँ अस्वीकृत दावों का सबसे आम स्रोत हैं।

segments.src: 4. **Read your contracts** for tariff pass-through and adjustment clauses, in both directions, before anyone assumes the refund is theirs.
segments.tr: 4. **अपने अनुबंधों को पढ़ें** टैरिफ पास-थ्रू और समायोजन क्लॉज के लिए, दोनों दिशाओं में, इससे पहले कि कोई यह मान ले कि रिफंड उनका है।

segments.src: 5. **Talk to your auditor early** about recognition timing so the refund does not become a surprise restatement conversation.
segments.tr: 5. **अपने ऑडिटर से जल्दी बात करें** मान्यता समय के बारे में ताकि रिफंड एक आश्चर्यजनक पुनर्कथन (restatement) बातचीत में न बदल जाए।

segments.src: 6. **Model the replacement duties**, not the old ones. Your forward cost curve depends on Section 232 scopes, not on a case you already won.
segments.tr: 6. **प्रतिस्थापन शुल्कों का मॉडल बनाएं**, पुराने शुल्कों का नहीं। आपका भविष्य का लागत वक्र धारा 232 के दायरे पर निर्भर करता है, न कि उस मामले पर जिसे आप पहले ही जीत चुके हैं।

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष (Bottom line)

segments.src: The Supreme Court answered a constitutional question cleanly: an emergency-powers statute that never mentions tariffs does not authorize them.
segments.tr: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने एक संवैधानिक प्रश्न का स्पष्ट उत्तर दिया: एक आपातकालीन-शक्ति कानून जो टैरिफ का उल्लेख नहीं करता है, उन्हें अधिकृत नहीं करता है।

segments.src: What it could not do is make an administrative system built for correcting individual entry errors process a nationwide reversal quickly, or prevent the executive branch from rebuilding similar duties through statutes that were always available and are now being used.
segments.tr: जो वह नहीं कर सका, वह यह था कि व्यक्तिगत प्रविष्टि त्रुटियों को सुधारने के लिए बने एक प्रशासनिक सिस्टम को राष्ट्रव्यापी उलटफेर को तेज़ी से प्रोसेस करने के लिए मजबूर करे, या कार्यकारी शाखा को उन कानूनों के माध्यम से समान शुल्क फिर से बनाने से रोके जो हमेशा उपलब्ध थे और अब उपयोग किए जा रहे हैं।

segments.src: For 330,000 companies, the ruling converted a cost into a receivable.
segments.tr: 330,000 कंपनियों के लिए, इस फैसले ने एक लागत को प्राप्य (receivable) में बदल दिया।

segments.src: That is a genuine improvement.
segments.tr: यह एक वास्तविक सुधार है।

segments.src: It is also a reminder that in trade law, the judgment is the beginning of the process, not the end of it — and that the distance between a court order and a bank deposit is measured in liquidation dates, not in principles.
segments.tr: यह इस बात की याद दिलाता है कि व्यापार कानून में, निर्णय प्रक्रिया की शुरुआत है, अंत नहीं — और यह कि कोर्ट के आदेश और बैंक जमा के बीच की दूरी लिक्विडेशन तिथियों में मापी जाती है, सिद्धांतों में नहीं।

segments.src: *This article is general information, not legal, tax, or accounting advice.
segments.tr: *यह लेख सामान्य जानकारी है, कानूनी, कर या लेखांकन सलाह नहीं है।

segments.src: Figures cited are estimates that shift as litigation and refund processing continue.
segments.tr: उद्धृत आंकड़े अनुमान हैं जो मुकदमेबाजी और रिफंड प्रोसेसिंग जारी रहने के साथ बदलते रहते हैं।

segments.src: Importers with potential claims should consult licensed customs counsel and their own advisors about their specific entries and deadlines.*
segments.tr: संभावित दावों वाले आयातकों को अपनी विशिष्ट प्रविष्टियों और समय सीमा के बारे में लाइसेंस प्राप्त सीमा शुल्क वकील और अपने सलाहकारों से परामर्श करना चाहिए।*

es.title: Ganaron en la Corte Suprema, pero siguen esperando el cheque: El interior del reembolso arancelario de 165.000 millones de dólares que nadie puede cobrar

segments.src: There is a peculiar kind of legal victory in which you win everything and receive nothing.
segments.tr: Existe un tipo peculiar de victoria legal en la que ganas todo y no recibes nada.

segments.src: Somewhere around 330,000 American importers are living in it right now.
segments.tr: Alrededor de 330.000 importadores estadounidenses están viviendo eso ahora mismo.

segments.src: Six months after the Supreme Court held, 6–3, that the International Emergency Economic Powers Act does not give any president the authority to impose tariffs, the courts have ordered roughly $165 billion in collected duties returned to the companies that paid them.
segments.tr: Seis meses después de que la Corte Suprema dictaminara, por 6 votos contra 3, que la Ley de Poderes Económicos de Emergencia Internacional (IEEPA) no otorga a ningún presidente la autoridad para imponer aranceles, los tribunales han ordenado la devolución de aproximadamente 165.000 millones de dólares en derechos recaudados a las empresas que los pagaron.

segments.src: On paper, that is one of the largest single refund events the U.S.
segments.tr: En el papel, este es uno de los eventos de reembolso único más grandes que el Tesoro de los EE. UU.

segments.src: Treasury has ever faced.
segments.tr: haya enfrentado jamás.

segments.src: In practice, most of the businesses entitled to that money have not seen a dollar of it — and a large share of them are still cutting tariff checks every week.
segments.tr: En la práctica, la mayoría de las empresas con derecho a ese dinero no han visto ni un dólar, y una gran parte de ellas siguen emitiendo cheques de aranceles cada semana.

segments.src: The gap between the ruling and the refund is not a scandal.
segments.tr: La brecha entre el fallo y el reembolso no es un escándalo.

segments.src: It is plumbing.
segments.tr: Es un problema de fontanería administrativa.

segments.src: But the plumbing is worth understanding, because it explains why a landmark constitutional decision has so far changed far less about the cost of importing goods into the United States than the headline suggested.
segments.tr: Pero vale la pena entender esa fontanería, porque explica por qué una decisión constitucional histórica ha cambiado, hasta ahora, mucho menos el costo de importar bienes a los Estados Unidos de lo que sugería el titular.

segments.src: ## What the Court actually decided
segments.tr: ## Lo que la Corte decidió realmente

segments.src: IEEPA, passed in 1977, lets a president declare a national emergency in response to an "unusual and extraordinary threat" originating largely outside the United States, and then take a list of economic actions — among them, the authority to "regulate ...
segments.tr: La IEEPA, aprobada en 1977, permite que un presidente declare una emergencia nacional en respuesta a una "amenaza inusual y extraordinaria" originada principalmente fuera de los Estados Unidos, y luego tome una serie de acciones económicas; entre ellas, la autoridad para "regular la...

segments.src: importation."
segments.tr: importación".

segments.src: The government's argument rested on those three words.
segments.tr: El argumento del gobierno se basaba en esas tres palabras.

segments.src: If you can regulate importation, the reasoning went, you can condition importation on payment of a duty.
segments.tr: Si se puede regular la importación, razonaban, se puede condicionar la importación al pago de un derecho.

segments.src: Emergencies are unpredictable, and Congress wrote the statute broadly on purpose.
segments.tr: Las emergencias son impredecibles, y el Congreso redactó el estatuto de manera amplia a propósito.

segments.src: The challengers — a group of small importers and a coalition of states, whose cases were consolidated on the way up — made a structural argument instead.
segments.tr: Los demandantes —un grupo de pequeños importadores y una coalición de estados, cuyos casos fueron consolidados en el proceso— plantearon, en cambio, un argumento estructural.

segments.src: The power to lay duties belongs to Congress under Article I.
segments.tr: El poder de imponer derechos pertenece al Congreso según el Artículo I.

segments.src: IEEPA never uses the words *tariff*, *duty*, or *tax*.
segments.tr: La IEEPA nunca utiliza las palabras *arancel*, *derecho* o *impuesto*.

segments.src: And in nearly fifty years, across administrations of both parties, no president had ever read the statute that way.
segments.tr: Y en casi cincuenta años, a través de administraciones de ambos partidos, ningún presidente había interpretado el estatuto de esa manera.

segments.src: The majority sided with the challengers, applying the now-familiar principle that Congress does not hide decisions of vast economic and political significance inside vague or ancillary statutory language.
segments.tr: La mayoría se puso del lado de los demandantes, aplicando el principio ahora familiar de que el Congreso no oculta decisiones de gran importancia económica y política dentro de un lenguaje estatutario vago o accesorio.

segments.src: The Court noted something telling: when Congress *has* delegated tariff authority, it has done so deliberately and with guardrails — required investigations, agency findings, rate ceilings, sunset clauses.
segments.tr: La Corte señaló algo revelador: cuando el Congreso *ha* delegado la autoridad arancelaria, lo ha hecho deliberadamente y con salvaguardas: investigaciones requeridas, hallazgos de agencias, techos de tasas, cláusulas de caducidad.

segments.src: IEEPA has none of those.
segments.tr: La IEEPA no tiene ninguna de ellas.

segments.src: The absence of any procedural machinery was treated as evidence that the machinery was never meant to be there.
segments.tr: La ausencia de cualquier maquinaria procesal fue tratada como evidencia de que la maquinaria nunca estuvo destinada a estar allí.

segments.src: The dissent argued for deference in the field of foreign affairs, and read "regulate importation" as plainly capacious enough to include a tariff.
segments.tr: El voto disidente abogó por la deferencia en el campo de los asuntos exteriores, e interpretó "regular la importación" como lo suficientemente amplio como para incluir un arancel.

segments.src: One point gets lost in the coverage: the decision is about *which branch* sets tariffs and *under which statute*.
segments.tr: Un punto se pierde en la cobertura: la decisión trata sobre *qué rama* establece los aranceles y *bajo qué estatuto*.

segments.src: It is not a ruling on whether tariffs are wise policy.
segments.tr: No es un fallo sobre si los aranceles son una política sensata.

segments.src: That distinction explains nearly everything that has happened since.
segments.tr: Esa distinción explica casi todo lo que ha sucedido desde entonces.

segments.src: ## Why winning is not the same as being paid
segments.tr: ## Por qué ganar no es lo mismo que cobrar

segments.src: Customs refunds do not work like a court-ordered settlement where a check gets mailed.
segments.tr: Los reembolsos de aduanas no funcionan como un acuerdo ordenado por el tribunal donde se envía un cheque por correo.

segments.src: They work entry by entry, through a system built for correcting individual paperwork errors, not for unwinding a policy applied to tens of millions of shipments.
segments.tr: Funcionan entrada por entrada, a través de un sistema diseñado para corregir errores individuales de papeleo, no para deshacer una política aplicada a decenas de millones de envíos.

segments.src: **Liquidation is the deadline nobody outside the trade world had heard of.** When goods enter the United States, the importer files an entry summary and deposits estimated duties.
segments.tr: **La liquidación es la fecha límite de la que nadie fuera del mundo del comercio había oído hablar.** Cuando las mercancías entran en los Estados Unidos, el importador presenta un resumen de entrada y deposita los derechos estimados.

segments.src: Months later, Customs and Border Protection "liquidates" the entry — the final, legally binding computation of what was owed.
segments.tr: Meses después, la Oficina de Aduanas y Protección Fronteriza (CBP) "liquida" la entrada: el cómputo final y legalmente vinculante de lo que se debía.

segments.src: Once an entry liquidates and the protest window closes, it is generally final.
segments.tr: Una vez que una entrada se liquida y se cierra la ventana de protesta, generalmente es final.

segments.src: Reopening it requires a specific legal hook.
segments.tr: Reabrirla requiere un anclaje legal específico.

segments.src: Many entries from the tariffs' earliest months liquidated long before the case reached the Supreme Court, and a meaningful slice of the theoretical $165 billion sits behind that door.
segments.tr: Muchas entradas de los primeros meses de los aranceles se liquidaron mucho antes de que el caso llegara a la Corte Suprema, y una parte significativa de los teóricos 165.000 millones de dólares queda detrás de esa puerta.

segments.src: **Being right is not the same as being a party.** Court orders run to the parties before the court.
segments.tr: **Tener razón no es lo mismo que ser parte.** Las órdenes judiciales se aplican a las partes ante el tribunal.

segments.src: Whether relief extends automatically to every importer in the country, or whether each company must file its own protest or suit to claim its share, has been litigated separately — and that secondary fight is where a great deal of the money is currently parked.
segments.tr: Si el alivio se extiende automáticamente a cada importador del país, o si cada empresa debe presentar su propia protesta o demanda para reclamar su parte, ha sido litigado por separado, y esa lucha secundaria es donde se encuentra actualmente gran parte del dinero.

segments.src: Importers who filed protective claims early are in a materially better position than those who waited for the news.
segments.tr: Los importadores que presentaron reclamaciones protectoras tempranas están en una posición materialmente mejor que aquellos que esperaron las noticias.

segments.src: **The refund itself is an accounting exercise at enormous scale.** CBP processes tens of millions of entry summaries a year.
segments.tr: **El reembolso en sí es un ejercicio contable a escala enorme.** La CBP procesa decenas de millones de resúmenes de entrada al año.

segments.src: Each refund has to be matched to a specific entry, a specific line, a specific tariff classification, and often a specific surety bond.
segments.tr: Cada reembolso debe coincidir con una entrada específica, una línea específica, una clasificación arancelaria específica y, a menudo, una fianza de garantía específica.

segments.src: Some entries mixed duties that are now void with duties that remain perfectly valid under other statutes.
segments.tr: Algunas entradas mezclaron derechos que ahora son nulos con derechos que siguen siendo perfectamente válidos bajo otros estatutos.

segments.src: Untangling those lines is manual work, and there is no button that does it.
segments.tr: Desenredar esas líneas es un trabajo manual, y no hay un botón que lo haga.
