segments.src: One point gets lost in the coverage: the decision is about *which branch* sets tariffs and *under which statute*.
segments.tr: Um ponto se perde na cobertura: a decisão é sobre *qual ramo* define as tarifas e *sob qual estatuto*.

segments.src: It is not a ruling on whether tariffs are wise policy.
segments.tr: Não é uma decisão sobre se as tarifas são uma política sensata.

segments.src: That distinction explains nearly everything that has happened since.
segments.tr: Essa distinção explica quase tudo o que aconteceu desde então.

segments.src: ## Why winning is not the same as being paid
segments.tr: ## Por que vencer não é o mesmo que ser pago

segments.src: Customs refunds do not work like a court-ordered settlement where a check gets mailed.
segments.tr: Reembolsos alfandegários não funcionam como um acordo ordenado pelo tribunal onde um cheque é enviado pelo correio.

segments.src: They work entry by entry, through a system built for correcting individual paperwork errors, not for unwinding a policy applied to tens of millions of shipments.
segments.tr: Eles funcionam entrada por entrada, através de um sistema construído para corrigir erros individuais de documentação, não para desfazer uma política aplicada a dezenas de milhões de remessas.

segments.src: **Liquidation is the deadline nobody outside the trade world had heard of.** When goods enter the United States, the importer files an entry summary and deposits estimated duties.
segments.tr: **A liquidação é o prazo que ninguém fora do mundo do comércio já ouviu falar.** Quando as mercadorias entram nos Estados Unidos, o importador apresenta um resumo de entrada e deposita os impostos estimados.

segments.src: Months later, Customs and Border Protection "liquidates" the entry — the final, legally binding computation of what was owed.
segments.tr: Meses depois, a Alfândega e Proteção de Fronteiras (CBP) "liquida" a entrada — o cálculo final e legalmente vinculativo do que era devido.

segments.src: Once an entry liquidates and the protest window closes, it is generally final.
segments.tr: Uma vez que a entrada é liquidada e a janela de contestação se fecha, ela é geralmente final.

segments.src: Reopening it requires a specific legal hook.
segments.tr: Reabri-la requer um gancho legal específico.

segments.src: Many entries from the tariffs' earliest months liquidated long before the case reached the Supreme Court, and a meaningful slice of the theoretical $165 billion sits behind that door.
segments.tr: Muitas entradas dos primeiros meses das tarifas foram liquidadas muito antes de o caso chegar à Suprema Corte, e uma fatia significativa dos teóricos US$ 165 bilhões está atrás dessa porta.

segments.src: **Being right is not the same as being a party.** Court orders run to the parties before the court.
segments.tr: **Estar certo não é o mesmo que ser parte.** Ordens judiciais aplicam-se às partes perante o tribunal.

segments.src: Whether relief extends automatically to every importer in the country, or whether each company must file its own protest or suit to claim its share, has been litigated separately — and that secondary fight is where a great deal of the money is currently parked.
segments.tr: Se o alívio se estende automaticamente a cada importador no país, ou se cada empresa deve apresentar sua própria contestação ou processo para reivindicar sua parte, tem sido litigado separadamente — e essa luta secundária é onde grande parte do dinheiro está atualmente estacionada.

segments.src: Importers who filed protective claims early are in a materially better position than those who waited for the news.
segments.tr: Importadores que apresentaram reivindicações protetivas precocemente estão em uma posição materialmente melhor do que aqueles que esperaram pelas notícias.

segments.src: **The refund itself is an accounting exercise at enormous scale.** CBP processes tens of millions of entry summaries a year.
segments.tr: **O reembolso em si é um exercício contábil em escala enorme.** O CBP processa dezenas de milhões de resumos de entrada por ano.

segments.src: Each refund has to be matched to a specific entry, a specific line, a specific tariff classification, and often a specific surety bond.
segments.tr: Cada reembolso deve ser correspondido a uma entrada específica, uma linha específica, uma classificação tarifária específica e, muitas vezes, uma fiança específica.

segments.src: Some entries mixed duties that are now void with duties that remain perfectly valid under other statutes.
segments.tr: Algumas entradas misturaram impostos que agora são nulos com impostos que permanecem perfeitamente válidos sob outros estatutos.

segments.src: Untangling those lines is manual work, and there is no button that does it.
segments.tr: Desvendar essas linhas é um trabalho manual, e não existe um botão que faça isso.

segments.src: **Interest accrues, which softens the wait but complicates the math.** Excess deposits generally carry interest from the date of deposit until refund, at rates Treasury resets quarterly.
segments.tr: **Os juros acumulam-se, o que suaviza a espera, mas complica a matemática.** Depósitos em excesso geralmente rendem juros desde a data do depósito até o reembolso, a taxas que o Tesouro redefine trimestralmente.

segments.src: For a company that paid millions in 2025, that is real money — and also a taxable event landing in a different fiscal year than the original expense.
segments.tr: Para uma empresa que pagou milhões em 2025, isso é dinheiro real — e também um evento tributável que cai em um ano fiscal diferente da despesa original.

segments.src: **Appeals and remands keep resetting the clock.** Even after a Supreme Court ruling on the core question, the downstream cases about scope, timing, and eligibility continue to move through the Court of International Trade and the Federal Circuit.
segments.tr: **Recursos e remessas continuam reiniciando o relógio.** Mesmo após uma decisão da Suprema Corte sobre a questão central, os casos subsequentes sobre escopo, tempo e elegibilidade continuam a tramitar no Tribunal de Comércio Internacional e no Circuito Federal.

segments.src: Every remand adds months.
segments.tr: Cada remessa adiciona meses.

segments.src: ## Who actually gets the money
segments.tr: ## Quem realmente recebe o dinheiro

segments.src: This is the question that produces the most awkward conversations inside companies.
segments.tr: Esta é a pergunta que produz as conversas mais constrangedoras dentro das empresas.

segments.src: The refund goes to the **importer of record** — the entity legally on the hook to CBP.
segments.tr: O reembolso vai para o **importador de registro** — a entidade legalmente responsável perante o CBP.

segments.src: That is often not the party that ultimately bore the cost.
segments.tr: Isso muitas vezes não é a parte que ultimamente arcou com o custo.

segments.src: A U.S.
segments.tr: Um

segments.src: distributor that paid the duty and raised its prices has already recovered much of it from customers.
segments.tr: distribuidor dos EUA que pagou o imposto e aumentou seus preços já recuperou grande parte disso dos clientes.

segments.src: A retailer that negotiated delivered-duty-paid terms may have pushed the cost onto a foreign supplier.
segments.tr: Um varejista que negociou termos de entrega com impostos pagos (DDP) pode ter empurrado o custo para um fornecedor estrangeiro.

segments.src: Some contracts contain explicit tariff-adjustment clauses that now run in reverse; most do not.
segments.tr: Alguns contratos contêm cláusulas explícitas de ajuste tarifário que agora funcionam ao contrário; a maioria não.

segments.src: The result is a wave of quiet commercial negotiation that has nothing to do with the constitutional question: *who, in this supply chain, owns this receivable?* Companies with clean documentation and well-drafted clauses are resolving it in weeks.
segments.tr: O resultado é uma onda de negociações comerciais silenciosas que não têm nada a ver com a questão constitucional: *quem, nesta cadeia de suprimentos, é dono deste valor a receber?* Empresas com documentação limpa e cláusulas bem redigidas estão resolvendo isso em semanas.

segments.src: Companies without are discovering that a windfall is only a windfall if you can prove it is yours.
segments.tr: Empresas sem isso estão descobrindo que um ganho inesperado só é um ganho inesperado se você puder provar que é seu.

segments.src: ## The wall that replaced the wall
segments.tr: ## O muro que substituiu o muro

segments.src: Here is the part that surprises people who followed only the headline.
segments.tr: Aqui está a parte que surpreende as pessoas que acompanharam apenas a manchete.

segments.src: For many importers, the total duty burden has not fallen much, because the tariffs did not disappear so much as change legal address.
segments.tr: Para muitos importadores, a carga tributária total não caiu muito, porque as tarifas não desapareceram, mas sim mudaram de endereço legal.

segments.src: IEEPA was the fast lane.
segments.tr: A IEEPA era a via rápida.

segments.src: Everything else is slower, narrower, and procedurally demanding — but it exists, and it has been used.
segments.tr: Todo o resto é mais lento, mais estreito e processualmente exigente — mas existe e tem sido usado.

segments.src: | Authority | What it requires | Practical constraints |
segments.tr: | Autoridade | O que requer | Restrições Práticas |

segments.src: | **Section 232** (Trade Expansion Act of 1962) | Commerce Department investigation finding that imports threaten national security | Product-by-product; investigations take months; no statutory rate cap |
segments.tr: | **Seção 232** (Lei de Expansão Comercial de 1962) | Investigação do Departamento de Comércio constatando que as importações ameaçam a segurança nacional | Produto por produto; investigações levam meses; sem teto tarifário estatutário |

segments.src: | **Section 301** (Trade Act of 1974) | USTR investigation into unfair foreign practices | Country-specific; notice-and-comment; subject to periodic review |
segments.tr: | **Seção 301** (Lei de Comércio de 1974) | Investigação do USTR sobre práticas estrangeiras desleais | Específico por país; aviso e comentário; sujeito a revisão periódica |

segments.src: | **Section 201** (Trade Act of 1974) | ITC finding of serious injury to a domestic industry | Temporary safeguard; must phase down over time |
segments.tr: | **Seção 201** (Lei de Comércio de 1974) | Constatação do ITC de dano grave a uma indústria doméstica | Salvaguarda temporária; deve ser reduzida gradualmente ao longo do tempo |

segments.src: | **Section 122** (Trade Act of 1974) | Balance-of-payments justification | Capped at 15% and 150 days without congressional action |
segments.tr: | **Seção 122** (Lei de Comércio de 1974) | Justificativa de balanço de pagamentos | Limitada a 15% e 150 dias sem ação do Congresso |

segments.src: Section 232 has done most of the work.
segments.tr: A Seção 232 fez a maior parte do trabalho.

segments.src: Because it is organized around product categories rather than countries, rebuilding coverage means running investigations sector by sector — steel and aluminum derivatives, autos and parts, copper, timber and lumber, pharmaceuticals, semiconductors and downstream electronics.
segments.tr: Como ela é organizada em torno de categorias de produtos em vez de países, reconstruir a cobertura significa realizar investigações setor por setor — derivados de aço e alumínio, carros e peças, cobre, madeira e madeiras serradas, produtos farmacêuticos, semicondutores e eletrônicos a jusante.

segments.src: Each one is a separate proceeding with its own comment docket and its own effective date.
segments.tr: Cada um é um processo separado com seu próprio dossiê de comentários e sua própria data de vigência.

segments.src: The practical effect for an importer is that a refund for last year's duties can arrive in the same quarter as a new invoice for this year's, on the same product, at a comparable rate, under a different statute.
segments.tr: O efeito prático para um importador é que um reembolso de impostos do ano passado pode chegar no mesmo trimestre que uma nova fatura para este ano, sobre o mesmo produto, a uma taxa comparável, sob um estatuto diferente.

segments.src: The money is real.
segments.tr: O dinheiro é real.

segments.src: The relief is not.
segments.tr: O alívio não é.

segments.src: ## What it means for the books
segments.tr: ## O que isso significa para a contabilidade

segments.src: Accountants have been unusually vocal about this one.
segments.tr: Os contadores têm sido excepcionalmente vocais sobre isso.

segments.src: Under U.S.
segments.tr: Sob o

segments.src: GAAP, gain contingencies generally are not recognized until realized or realizable — so a company cannot simply book its expected refund as an asset because it read a favorable opinion.
segments.tr: GAAP dos EUA, contingências de ganho geralmente não são reconhecidas até serem realizadas ou realizáveis — portanto, uma empresa não pode simplesmente registrar seu reembolso esperado como um ativo porque leu um parecer favorável.

segments.src: The original tariffs were typically expensed through cost of goods sold or capitalized into inventory.
segments.tr: As tarifas originais foram tipicamente lançadas como despesa através do custo dos produtos vendidos ou capitalizadas no estoque.

segments.src: The refunds, when they land, tend to arrive as a lump in a later period, distorting margins in a quarter that had nothing to do with the shipments in question.
segments.tr: Os reembolsos, quando chegam, tendem a chegar como um montante global em um período posterior, distorcendo as margens em um trimestre que não teve nada a ver com as remessas em questão.

segments.src: That timing mismatch is why some importers with large confirmed claims still look, on paper, like they are absorbing tariff costs.
segments.tr: Esse descompasso de tempo é a razão pela qual alguns importadores com grandes reivindicações confirmadas ainda parecem, no papel, estar absorvendo custos tarifários.

segments.src: They are — until the money moves.
segments.tr: Eles estão — até que o dinheiro se mova.

segments.src: ## What it means for prices
segments.tr: ## O que isso significa para os preços

segments.src: Prices are famously sticky downward.
segments.tr: Os preços são famosamente rígidos para baixo.

segments.src: Costs that got passed to consumers over two years do not reverse on the day a court rules, particularly when replacement duties are landing in the same categories.
segments.tr: Custos que foram repassados aos consumidores ao longo de dois anos não revertem no dia em que um tribunal decide, particularmente quando impostos de substituição estão chegando nas mesmas categorias.

segments.src: Where relief has shown up fastest is in goods that fell outside every Section 232 product scope — certain consumer categories, some apparel and household goods, various inputs with no plausible national-security framing.
segments.tr: Onde o alívio apareceu mais rapidamente foi em mercadorias que ficaram fora de todo o escopo de produtos da Seção 232 — certas categorias de consumo, algumas roupas e artigos domésticos, várias entradas sem enquadramento plausível de segurança nacional.

segments.src: Where it has shown up least is anywhere touching metals, vehicles, electronics, or pharmaceuticals.
segments.tr: Onde menos apareceu foi em qualquer coisa relacionada a metais, veículos, eletrônicos ou produtos farmacêuticos.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## O que observar a seguir

segments.src: - **The scope litigation.** Whether relief reaches non-parties automatically is worth more, in dollars, than most of the underlying case.
segments.tr: - **O litígio de escopo.** Se o alívio atinge as partes não envolvidas automaticamente vale mais, em dólares, do que a maior parte do caso subjacente.

segments.src: - **The liquidation cutoff rulings.** Courts are being asked whether finality bars claims on entries that liquidated before the decision. This is the single largest variable in the $165 billion estimate.
segments.tr: - **As decisões de corte de liquidação.** Os tribunais estão sendo questionados se a finalidade barra reivindicações sobre entradas que foram liquidadas antes da decisão. Esta é a maior variável única na estimativa de US$ 165 bilhões.

segments.src: - **CBP's processing pace.** Refund throughput, not legal entitlement, now sets the calendar for most companies.
segments.tr: - **O ritmo de processamento do CBP.** A capacidade de processamento de reembolsos, e não o direito legal, agora define o calendário para a maioria das empresas.

segments.src: - **New Section 232 proceedings.** Each new product scope narrows the practical benefit of the refund for affected importers.
segments.tr: - **Novos processos da Seção 232.** Cada novo escopo de produto reduz o benefício prático do reembolso para os importadores afetados.

segments.src: - **Congress.** The decision hands tariff-setting back to the legislature by default. Whether Congress legislates new delegated authority, tightens the existing ones, or does nothing will determine what the next version of this looks like.
segments.tr: - **O Congresso.** A decisão devolve a definição de tarifas ao legislativo por padrão. Se o Congresso legislará nova autoridade delegada, apertará as existentes ou não fará nada determinará como será a próxima versão disso.

segments.src: ## A practical checklist for importers
segments.tr: ## Um checklist prático para importadores

segments.src: If your company imported during the affected period, the useful steps are unglamorous:
segments.tr: Se a sua empresa importou durante o período afetado, as etapas úteis são pouco glamourosas:

segments.src: 1. **Pull your entry data.** Identify every entry summary in the window and its liquidation status. You cannot claim what you cannot locate.
segments.tr: 1. **Extraia seus dados de entrada.** Identifique cada resumo de entrada na janela e seu status de liquidação. Você não pode reivindicar o que não consegue localizar.

segments.src: 2. **Preserve rights on unliquidated entries** through the appropriate protest or post-summary correction channels, with customs counsel, before deadlines pass.
segments.tr: 2. **Preserve os direitos sobre entradas não liquidadas** através dos canais de contestação ou correção pós-resumo apropriados, com um advogado alfandegário, antes que os prazos expirem.

segments.src: 3. **Separate voided duties from valid ones** line by line. Mixed entries are the most common source of rejected claims.
segments.tr: 3. **Separe os impostos nulos dos válidos** linha por linha. Entradas mistas são a fonte mais comum de reivindicações rejeitadas.

segments.src: 4. **Read your contracts** for tariff pass-through and adjustment clauses, in both directions, before anyone assumes the refund is theirs.
segments.tr: 4. **Leia seus contratos** para cláusulas de repasse e ajuste tarifário, em ambas as direções, antes que qualquer pessoa assuma que o reembolso é dela.

segments.src: 5. **Talk to your auditor early** about recognition timing so the refund does not become a surprise restatement conversation.
segments.tr: 5. **Fale com seu auditor precocemente** sobre o momento do reconhecimento, para que o reembolso não se torne uma conversa de republicação de demonstrações financeiras surpresa.

segments.src: 6. **Model the replacement duties**, not the old ones. Your forward cost curve depends on Section 232 scopes, not on a case you already won.
segments.tr: 6. **Modele os impostos de substituição**, não os antigos. Sua curva de custo futuro depende dos escopos da Seção 232, não de um caso que você já venceu.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Conclusão

segments.src: The Supreme Court answered a constitutional question cleanly: an emergency-powers statute that never mentions tariffs does not authorize them.
segments.tr: A Suprema Corte respondeu a uma questão constitucional de forma clara: um estatuto de poderes de emergência que nunca menciona tarifas não as autoriza.

segments.src: What it could not do is make an administrative system built for correcting individual entry errors process a nationwide reversal quickly, or prevent the executive branch from rebuilding similar duties through statutes that were always available and are now being used.
segments.tr: O que ela não pôde fazer foi fazer com que um sistema administrativo construído para corrigir erros de entrada individuais processe uma reversão nacional rapidamente, ou impedir que o poder executivo reconstrua impostos semelhantes através de estatutos que sempre estiveram disponíveis e que agora estão sendo usados.

segments.src: For 330,000 companies, the ruling converted a cost into a receivable.
segments.tr: Para 330.000 empresas, a decisão converteu um custo em um valor a receber.

segments.src: That is a genuine improvement.
segments.tr: Isso é uma melhoria genuína.

segments.src: It is also a reminder that in trade law, the judgment is the beginning of the process, not the end of it — and that the distance between a court order and a bank deposit is measured in liquidation dates, not in principles.
segments.tr: É também um lembrete de que, no direito comercial, a sentença é o começo do processo, não o fim — e que a distância entre uma ordem judicial e um depósito bancário é medida em datas de liquidação, não em princípios.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not legal, tax, or accounting advice.
segments.tr: *Este artigo fornece informações gerais, não conselhos jurídicos, fiscais ou contábeis.

segments.src: Figures cited are estimates that shift as litigation and refund processing continue.
segments.tr: Os números citados são estimativas que mudam à medida que o litígio e o processamento de reembolsos continuam.

segments.src: Importers with potential claims should consult licensed customs counsel and their own advisors about their specific entries and deadlines.*
segments.tr: Importadores com reivindicações potenciais devem consultar advogados alfandegários licenciados e seus próprios consultores sobre suas entradas e prazos específicos.*

in.title: Menang di Mahkamah Agung, Masih Menunggu Cek: Di Balik Pengembalian Tarif $165 Miliar yang Tidak Bisa Dicairkan Siapa Pun

segments.src: There is a peculiar kind of legal victory in which you win everything and receive nothing.
segments.tr: Ada jenis kemenangan hukum yang aneh di mana Anda memenangkan segalanya tetapi tidak menerima apa pun.

segments.src: Somewhere around 330,000 American importers are living in it right now.
segments.tr: Sekitar 330.000 pengimpor AS mengalami situasi tersebut saat ini.

segments.src: Six months after the Supreme Court held, 6–3, that the International Emergency Economic Powers Act does not give any president the authority to impose tariffs, the courts have ordered roughly $165 billion in collected duties returned to the companies that paid them.
segments.tr: Enam bulan setelah Mahkamah Agung memutuskan, 6–3, bahwa Undang-Undang Kekuatan Ekonomi Darurat Internasional (IEEPA) tidak memberikan wewenang kepada presiden mana pun untuk mengenakan tarif, pengadilan telah memerintahkan pengembalian bea yang telah dikumpulkan sebesar $165 miliar kepada perusahaan-perusahaan yang membayarnya.

segments.src: On paper, that is one of the largest single refund events the U.S.
segments.tr: Di atas kertas, itu adalah salah satu peristiwa pengembalian dana tunggal terbesar yang pernah dihadapi Kementerian Keuangan U.S.

segments.src: Treasury has ever faced.
segments.tr: Treasury.

segments.src: In practice, most of the businesses entitled to that money have not seen a dollar of it — and a large share of them are still cutting tariff checks every week.
segments.tr: Dalam praktiknya, sebagian besar bisnis yang berhak atas uang tersebut belum melihat satu dolar pun — dan sebagian besar dari mereka masih membayar cek tarif setiap minggu.

segments.src: The gap between the ruling and the refund is not a scandal.
segments.tr: Kesenjangan antara keputusan dan pengembalian dana bukanlah sebuah skandal.

segments.src: It is plumbing.
segments.tr: Ini adalah masalah sistem teknis.

segments.src: But the plumbing is worth understanding, because it explains why a landmark constitutional decision has so far changed far less about the cost of importing goods into the United States than the headline suggested.
segments.tr: Namun sistem teknis ini layak untuk dipahami, karena ini menjelaskan mengapa keputusan konstitusional yang monumental sejauh ini mengubah jauh lebih sedikit tentang biaya pengimporan barang ke Amerika Serikat daripada yang disiratkan oleh judul berita.

segments.src: ## What the Court actually decided
segments.tr: ## Apa yang sebenarnya diputuskan oleh Pengadilan

segments.src: IEEPA, passed in 1977, lets a president declare a national emergency in response to an "unusual and extraordinary threat" originating largely outside the United States, and then take a list of economic actions — among them, the authority to "regulate ...
segments.tr: IEEPA, yang disahkan pada tahun 1977, memungkinkan seorang presiden untuk menyatakan keadaan darurat nasional sebagai tanggapan terhadap "ancaman luar biasa dan tidak biasa" yang berasal dari luar Amerika Serikat, dan kemudian mengambil tindakan ekonomi — di antaranya, wewenang untuk "mengatur ...

segments.src: importation."
segments.tr: impor."

segments.src: The government's argument rested on those three words.
segments.tr: Argumen pemerintah didasarkan pada tiga kata tersebut.

segments.src: If you can regulate importation, the reasoning went, you can condition importation on payment of a duty.
segments.tr: Jika Anda dapat mengatur impor, demikian penalarannya, Anda dapat mensyaratkan impor atas pembayaran bea.

segments.src: Emergencies are unpredictable, and Congress wrote the statute broadly on purpose.
segments.tr: Keadaan darurat tidak dapat diprediksi, dan Kongres sengaja menulis undang-undang tersebut secara luas.

segments.src: The challengers — a group of small importers and a coalition of states, whose cases were consolidated on the way up — made a structural argument instead.
segments.tr: Para penggugat — sekelompok pengimpor kecil dan koalisi negara bagian, yang kasusnya digabungkan saat menuju ke tingkat atas — mengajukan argumen struktural sebagai gantinya.

segments.src: The power to lay duties belongs to Congress under Article I.
segments.tr: Wewenang untuk mengenakan bea milik Kongres berdasarkan Pasal I.

segments.src: IEEPA never uses the words *tariff*, *duty*, or *tax*.
segments.tr: IEEPA tidak pernah menggunakan kata *tarif*, *bea*, atau *pajak*.

segments.src: And in nearly fifty years, across administrations of both parties, no president had ever read the statute that way.
segments.tr: Dan selama hampir lima puluh tahun, di seluruh pemerintahan dari kedua partai, tidak ada presiden yang pernah menafsirkan undang-undang dengan cara seperti itu.

segments.src: The majority sided with the challengers, applying the now-familiar principle that Congress does not hide decisions of vast economic and political significance inside vague or ancillary statutory language.
segments.tr: Mayoritas berpihak pada penggugat, menerapkan prinsip yang sekarang sudah biasa bahwa Kongres tidak menyembunyikan keputusan-keputusan yang memiliki signifikansi ekonomi dan politik yang sangat besar di dalam bahasa undang-undang yang samar atau berspesifikasi sekunder.

segments.src: The Court noted something telling: when Congress *has* delegated tariff authority, it has done so deliberately and with guardrails — required investigations, agency findings, rate ceilings, sunset clauses.
segments.tr: Pengadilan mencatat sesuatu yang membuka mata: ketika Kongres *telah* mendelegasikan wewenang tarif, Kongres melakukannya secara sengaja dan dengan batasan-batasan — penyelidikan yang diperlukan, temuan badan resmi, batas atas tarif, pasal klausul kedaluwarsa (sunset clauses).

segments.src: IEEPA has none of those.
segments.tr: IEEPA tidak memiliki satu pun dari itu.

segments.src: The absence of any procedural machinery was treated as evidence that the machinery was never meant to be there.
segments.tr: Ketidakberadaan mekanisme prosedural apa pun diperlakukan sebagai bukti bahwa mekanisme tersebut memang tidak pernah dimaksudkan ada di sana.

segments.src: The dissent argued for deference in the field of foreign affairs, and read "regulate importation" as plainly capacious enough to include a tariff.
segments.tr: Pendapat yang berbeda (dissenting opinion) berpendapat untuk memberikan penghormatan dalam bidang urusan luar negeri, dan membaca "mengatur impor" sebagai hal yang cukup luas untuk mencakup tarif.

segments.src: One point gets lost in the coverage: the decision is about *which branch* sets tariffs and *under which statute*.
segments.tr: Satu poin hilang dalam liputan berita: keputusan tersebut adalah tentang *cabang kekuasaan mana* yang menetapkan tarif dan *di bawah undang-undang mana*.

segments.src: It is not a ruling on whether tariffs are wise policy.
segments.tr: Ini bukanlah keputusan tentang apakah tarif merupakan kebijakan yang bijaksana.

segments.src: That distinction explains nearly everything that has happened since.
segments.tr: Pembedaan itu menjelaskan hampir semua hal yang terjadi sejak saat itu.

segments.src: ## Why winning is not the same as being paid
segments.tr: ## Mengapa menang tidak sama dengan dibayar

segments.src: Customs refunds do not work like a court-ordered settlement where a check gets mailed.
segments.tr: Pengembalian dana bea cukai tidak bekerja seperti penyelesaian yang diperintahkan pengadilan di mana cek dikirimkan melalui pos.

segments.src: They work entry by entry, through a system built for correcting individual paperwork errors, not for unwinding a policy applied to tens of millions of shipments.
segments.tr: Pengembalian dana bekerja per entri, melalui sistem yang dibangun untuk mengoreksi kesalahan dokumen individu, bukan untuk membatalkan kebijakan yang diterapkan pada puluhan juta pengiriman.

segments.src: **Liquidation is the deadline nobody outside the trade world had heard of.** When goods enter the United States, the importer files an entry summary and deposits estimated duties.
segments.tr: **Likuidasi adalah tenggat waktu yang tidak pernah didengar oleh siapa pun di luar dunia perdagangan.** Ketika barang memasuki Amerika Serikat, pengimpor mengajukan ringkasan entri (entry summary) dan menyetorkan estimasi bea.

segments.src: Months later, Customs and Border Protection "liquidates" the entry — the final, legally binding computation of what was owed.
segments.tr: Beberapa bulan kemudian, Customs and Border Protection "melikuidasi" entri tersebut — perhitungan akhir yang mengikat secara hukum atas apa yang terutang.

segments.src: Once an entry liquidates and the protest window closes, it is generally final.
segments.tr: Setelah entri dilikuidasi dan jendela protes ditutup, hal itu umumnya bersifat final.

segments.src: Reopening it requires a specific legal hook.
segments.tr: Membukanya kembali memerlukan kaitan hukum tertentu.

segments.src: Many entries from the tariffs' earliest months liquidated long before the case reached the Supreme Court, and a meaningful slice of the theoretical $165 billion sits behind that door.
segments.tr: Banyak entri dari bulan-bulan awal pengenaan tarif telah dilikuidasi jauh sebelum kasus tersebut mencapai Mahkamah Agung, dan sebagian besar dari $165 miliar secara teoritis berada di balik pintu tersebut.

segments.src: **Being right is not the same as being a party.** Court orders run to the parties before the court.
segments.tr: **Berada di pihak yang benar tidak sama dengan menjadi pihak dalam perkara.** Perintah pengadilan berlaku untuk para pihak di depan pengadilan.

segments.src: Whether relief extends automatically to every importer in the country, or whether each company must file its own protest or suit to claim its share, has been litigated separately — and that secondary fight is where a great deal of the money is currently parked.
segments.tr: Apakah ganti rugi mencakup secara otomatis setiap pengimpor di negara tersebut, atau apakah setiap perusahaan harus mengajukan protes atau gugatan sendiri untuk mengklaim bagiannya, telah diperkarakan secara terpisah — dan pertarungan sekunder itulah tempat sebagian besar uang tersebut saat ini tertahan.

segments.src: Importers who filed protective claims early are in a materially better position than those who waited for the news.
segments.tr: Pengimpor yang mengajukan klaim perlindungan lebih awal berada dalam posisi yang jauh lebih baik daripada mereka yang menunggu berita.

segments.src: **The refund itself is an accounting exercise at enormous scale.** CBP processes tens of millions of entry summaries a year.
segments.tr: **Pengembalian dana itu sendiri adalah latihan akuntansi dalam skala yang sangat besar.** CBP memproses puluhan juta ringkasan entri setahun.

segments.src: Each refund has to be matched to a specific entry, a specific line, a specific tariff classification, and often a specific surety bond.
segments.tr: Setiap pengembalian dana harus dicocokkan dengan entri tertentu, baris tertentu, klasifikasi tarif tertentu, dan sering kali jaminan (surety bond) tertentu.

segments.src: Some entries mixed duties that are now void with duties that remain perfectly valid under other statutes.
segments.tr: Beberapa entri mencampurkan bea yang sekarang batal dengan bea yang tetap berlaku sepenuhnya di bawah undang-undang lain.

segments.src: Untangling those lines is manual work, and there is no button that does it.
segments.tr: Mengurai baris-baris tersebut adalah pekerjaan manual, dan tidak ada tombol otomatis yang dapat melakukannya.

segments.src: **Interest accrues, which softens the wait but complicates the math.** Excess deposits generally carry interest from the date of deposit until refund, at rates Treasury resets quarterly.
segments.tr: **Bunga bertambah, yang meringankan penantian tetapi memperumit perhitungan.** Kelebihan setoran umumnya membawa bunga sejak tanggal penyetoran hingga pengembalian dana, dengan suku bunga yang ditetapkan kembali oleh Treasury setiap kuartal.

segments.src: For a company that paid millions in 2025, that is real money — and also a taxable event landing in a different fiscal year than the original expense.
segments.tr: Bagi perusahaan yang membayar jutaan dolar pada tahun 2025, itu adalah uang nyata — dan juga peristiwa kena pajak yang jatuh pada tahun fiskal yang berbeda dari pengeluaran asli.

segments.src: **Appeals and remands keep resetting the clock.** Even after a Supreme Court ruling on the core question, the downstream cases about scope, timing, and eligibility continue to move through the Court of International Trade and the Federal Circuit.
segments.tr: **Banding dan pengembalian berkas perkara (remand) terus mereset waktu.** Bahkan setelah keputusan Mahkamah Agung tentang pertanyaan inti, kasus-kasus turunan tentang ruang lingkup, waktu, dan kelayakan terus bergerak melalui Court of International Trade dan Federal Circuit.

segments.src: Every remand adds months.
segments.tr: Setiap remand menambah penundaan berbulan-bulan.

segments.src: ## Who actually gets the money
segments.tr: ## Siapa yang sebenarnya mendapatkan uang tersebut

segments.src: This is the question that produces the most awkward conversations inside companies.
segments.tr: Ini adalah pertanyaan yang menimbulkan percakapan paling canggung di dalam perusahaan.

segments.src: The refund goes to the **importer of record** — the entity legally on the hook to CBP.
segments.tr: Pengembalian dana diberikan kepada **importer of record** — entitas yang secara hukum bertanggung jawab kepada CBP.

segments.src: That is often not the party that ultimately bore the cost.
segments.tr: Itu sering kali bukan pihak yang pada akhirnya menanggung biaya tersebut.

segments.src: A U.S.
segments.tr: Distributor U.S.

segments.src: distributor that paid the duty and raised its prices has already recovered much of it from customers.
segments.tr: yang membayar bea dan menaikkan harganya telah memperoleh kembali sebagian besar biaya tersebut dari pelanggan.

segments.src: A retailer that negotiated delivered-duty-paid terms may have pushed the cost onto a foreign supplier.
segments.tr: Pengecer yang menegosiasikan persyaratan delivered-duty-paid mungkin telah membebankan biaya tersebut kepada pemasok asing.

segments.src: Some contracts contain explicit tariff-adjustment clauses that now run in reverse; most do not.
segments.tr: Beberapa kontrak berisi klausul penyesuaian tarif eksplisit yang sekarang berjalan terbalik; sebagian besar tidak.

segments.src: The result is a wave of quiet commercial negotiation that has nothing to do with the constitutional question: *who, in this supply chain, owns this receivable?* Companies with clean documentation and well-drafted clauses are resolving it in weeks.
segments.tr: Hasilnya adalah gelombang negosiasi komersial secara diam-diam yang tidak ada hubungannya dengan pertanyaan konstitusional: *siapa, dalam rantai pasokan ini, yang memiliki piutang ini?* Perusahaan dengan dokumentasi bersih dan klausul yang dirancang dengan baik menyelesaikannya dalam hitungan minggu.

segments.src: Companies without are discovering that a windfall is only a windfall if you can prove it is yours.
segments.tr: Perusahaan tanpa hal tersebut mendapati bahwa keuntungan tak terduga hanya menjadi keuntungan jika Anda dapat membuktikan bahwa itu adalah milik Anda.

segments.src: ## The wall that replaced the wall
segments.tr: ## Dinding yang menggantikan dinding

segments.src: Here is the part that surprises people who followed only the headline.
segments.tr: Inilah bagian yang mengejutkan orang-orang yang hanya mengikuti judul berita.

segments.src: For many importers, the total duty burden has not fallen much, because the tariffs did not disappear so much as change legal address.
segments.tr: Bagi banyak pengimpor, total beban bea tidak banyak berkurang, karena tarif tersebut tidak begitu saja menghilang melainkan hanya berganti alamat hukum.

segments.src: IEEPA was the fast lane.
segments.tr: IEEPA adalah jalur cepat.

segments.src: Everything else is slower, narrower, and procedurally demanding — but it exists, and it has been used.
segments.tr: Segala hal lainnya lebih lambat, lebih sempit, dan menuntut secara prosedural — tetapi itu ada, dan telah digunakan.

segments.src: | Authority | What it requires | Practical constraints |
segments.tr: | Dasar Hukum | Apa yang dipersyaratkan | Kendala praktis |

segments.src: | **Section 232** (Trade Expansion Act of 1962) | Commerce Department investigation finding that imports threaten national security | Product-by-product; investigations take months; no statutory rate cap |
segments.tr: | **Pasal 232** (Trade Expansion Act of 1962) | Penyelidikan Departemen Perdagangan yang menemukan bahwa impor mengancam keamanan nasional | Per kategori produk; penyelidikan memakan waktu berbulan-bulan; tidak ada batas tarif undang-undang |

segments.src: | **Section 301** (Trade Act of 1974) | USTR investigation into unfair foreign practices | Country-specific; notice-and-comment; subject to periodic review |
segments.tr: | **Pasal 301** (Trade Act of 1974) | Penyelidikan USTR terhadap praktik asing yang tidak adil | Khusus negara tertentu; pemberitahuan dan tanggapan publik; tunduk pada peninjauan berkala |

segments.src: | **Section 201** (Trade Act of 1974) | ITC finding of serious injury to a domestic industry | Temporary safeguard; must phase down over time |
segments.tr: | **Pasal 201** (Trade Act of 1974) | Temuan ITC mengenai kerugian serius terhadap industri dalam negeri | Perlindungan sementara; harus diturunkan secara bertahap seiring waktu |

segments.src: | **Section 122** (Trade Act of 1974) | Balance-of-payments justification | Capped at 15% and 150 days without congressional action |
segments.tr: | **Pasal 122** (Trade Act of 1974) | Pembenaran neraca pembayaran | Dibatasi maksimal 15% dan 150 hari tanpa tindakan Kongres |

segments.src: Section 232 has done most of the work.
segments.tr: Pasal 232 telah melakukan sebagian besar pekerjaan tersebut.

segments.src: Because it is organized around product categories rather than countries, rebuilding coverage means running investigations sector by sector — steel and aluminum derivatives, autos and parts, copper, timber and lumber, pharmaceuticals, semiconductors and downstream electronics.
segments.tr: Karena diatur di sekitar kategori produk daripada negara, membangun kembali cakupan berarti menjalankan penyelidikan sektor demi sektor — turunan baja dan aluminium, otomotif dan suku cadang, tembaga, kayu dan kayu olahan, farmasi, semikonduktor, dan elektronik downstream.

segments.src: Each one is a separate proceeding with its own comment docket and its own effective date.
segments.tr: Masing-masing merupakan proses terpisah dengan dokumen tanggapan sendiri dan tanggal efektifnya sendiri.

segments.src: The practical effect for an importer is that a refund for last year's duties can arrive in the same quarter as a new invoice for this year's, on the same product, at a comparable rate, under a different statute.
segments.tr: Efek praktis bagi pengimpor adalah bahwa pengembalian dana untuk bea tahun lalu dapat tiba pada kuartal yang sama dengan faktur baru untuk tahun ini, atas produk yang sama, dengan tarif yang sebanding, di bawah undang-undang yang berbeda.

segments.src: The money is real.
segments.tr: Uang itu nyata.

segments.src: The relief is not.
segments.tr: Peringanan itu tidak nyata.

segments.src: ## What it means for the books
segments.tr: ## Apa artinya bagi pembukuan

segments.src: Accountants have been unusually vocal about this one.
segments.tr: Para akuntan sangat vokal mengenai hal yang satu ini.

segments.src: Under U.S.
segments.tr: Di bawah U.S.

segments.src: GAAP, gain contingencies generally are not recognized until realized or realizable — so a company cannot simply book its expected refund as an asset because it read a favorable opinion.
segments.tr: GAAP, keuntungan bersyarat (gain contingencies) umumnya tidak diakui sampai direalisasikan atau dapat direalisasikan — sehingga perusahaan tidak dapat begitu saja mencatat perkiraan pengembalian dananya sebagai aset karena membaca opini yang menguntungkan.

segments.src: The original tariffs were typically expensed through cost of goods sold or capitalized into inventory.
segments.tr: Tarif awal biasanya dibebankan melalui harga pokok penjualan atau dikapitalisasi ke dalam persediaan.

segments.src: The refunds, when they land, tend to arrive as a lump in a later period, distorting margins in a quarter that had nothing to do with the shipments in question.
segments.tr: Pengembalian dana, ketika masuk, cenderung tiba sekaligus dalam jumlah besar pada periode berikutnya, memutarbalikkan margin pada kuartal yang tidak ada hubungannya dengan pengiriman yang bersangkutan.

segments.src: That timing mismatch is why some importers with large confirmed claims still look, on paper, like they are absorbing tariff costs.
segments.tr: Kecocokan waktu yang tidak pas itulah yang menyebabkan mengapa beberapa pengimpor dengan klaim terkonfirmasi yang besar masih terlihat, di atas kertas, seolah-olah mereka menanggung biaya tarif.

segments.src: They are — until the money moves.
segments.tr: Mereka memang menanggungnya — sampai uang itu benar-benar berpindah.

segments.src: ## What it means for prices
segments.tr: ## Apa artinya bagi harga-harga

segments.src: Prices are famously sticky downward.
segments.tr: Harga-harga terkenal kaku untuk turun.

segments.src: Costs that got passed to consumers over two years do not reverse on the day a court rules, particularly when replacement duties are landing in the same categories.
segments.tr: Biaya yang diteruskan ke konsumen selama dua tahun tidak akan berbalik pada hari pengadilan memberikan keputusan, terutama ketika bea pengganti mendarat di kategori yang sama.

segments.src: Where relief has shown up fastest is in goods that fell outside every Section 232 product scope — certain consumer categories, some apparel and household goods, various inputs with no plausible national-security framing.
segments.tr: Di mana peringanan muncul paling cepat adalah pada barang-barang yang jatuh di luar setiap ruang lingkup produk Pasal 232 — kategori konsumen tertentu, beberapa pakaian dan barang rumah tangga, berbagai input tanpa kerangka keamanan nasional yang masuk akal.

segments.src: Where it has shown up least is anywhere touching metals, vehicles, electronics, or pharmaceuticals.
segments.tr: Di mana peringanan paling sedikit terlihat adalah di mana pun yang menyentuh logam, kendaraan, elektronik, atau farmasi.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang perlu diperhatikan selanjutnya

segments.src: - **The scope litigation.** Whether relief reaches non-parties automatically is worth more, in dollars, than most of the underlying case.
segments.tr: - **Litigasi ruang lingkup.** Apakah peringanan menjangkau pihak non-perkara secara otomatis bernilai lebih tinggi, dalam dolar, daripada sebagian besar kasus utama itu sendiri.

segments.src: - **The liquidation cutoff rulings.** Courts are being asked whether finality bars claims on entries that liquidated before the decision. This is the single largest variable in the $165 billion estimate.
segments.tr: - **Keputusan batas waktu likuidasi.** Pengadilan sedang ditanya apakah sifat final menghalangi klaim atas entri yang dilikuidasi sebelum keputusan. Ini adalah variabel tunggal terbesar dalam estimasi $165 miliar.

segments.src: - **CBP's processing pace.** Refund throughput, not legal entitlement, now sets the calendar for most companies.
segments.tr: - **Kecepatan pemrosesan CBP.** Kecepatan alur pengembalian dana, bukan hak hukum, yang kini menetapkan kalender bagi sebagian besar perusahaan.

segments.src: - **New Section 232 proceedings.** Each new product scope narrows the practical benefit of the refund for affected importers.
segments.tr: - **Prosedur Pasal 232 baru.** Setiap cakupan produk baru mempersempit manfaat praktis dari pengembalian dana bagi importir yang terdampak.

segments.src: - **Congress.** The decision hands tariff-setting back to the legislature by default. Whether Congress legislates new delegated authority, tightens the existing ones, or does nothing will determine what the next version of this looks like.
segments.tr: - **Kongres.** Keputusan tersebut mengembalikan penetapan tarif kepada lembaga legislatif secara default. Apakah Kongres membuat undang-undang wewenang terdelegasi yang baru, memperketat wewenang yang ada, atau tidak melakukan apa pun akan menentukan seperti apa bentuk versi berikutnya dari hal ini.

segments.src: ## A practical checklist for importers
segments.tr: ## Daftar periksa praktis untuk pengimpor

segments.src: If your company imported during the affected period, the useful steps are unglamorous:
segments.tr: Jika perusahaan Anda melakukan impor selama periode terdampak, langkah-langkah berguna tidaklah rumit:

segments.src: 1. **Pull your entry data.** Identify every entry summary in the window and its liquidation status. You cannot claim what you cannot locate.
segments.tr: 1. **Tarik data entri Anda.** Identifikasi setiap ringkasan entri dalam jendela waktu tersebut beserta status likuidasinya. Anda tidak dapat mengklaim apa yang tidak dapat Anda temukan.

segments.src: 2. **Preserve rights on unliquidated entries** through the appropriate protest or post-summary correction channels, with customs counsel, before deadlines pass.
segments.tr: 2. **Pertahankan hak pada entri yang belum dilikuidasi** melalui saluran protes yang sesuai atau koreksi pasca-ringkasan (post-summary correction), dengan penasihat bea cukai, sebelum tenggat waktu berlalu.

segments.src: 3. **Separate voided duties from valid ones** line by line. Mixed entries are the most common source of rejected claims.
segments.tr: 3. **Pisahkan bea yang dibatalkan dari bea yang sah** baris demi baris. Entri campuran adalah sumber paling umum dari klaim yang ditolak.

segments.src: 4. **Read your contracts** for tariff pass-through and adjustment clauses, in both directions, before anyone assumes the refund is theirs.
segments.tr: 4. **Baca kontrak Anda** untuk klausul penyesuaian dan penerusan tarif, di kedua arah, sebelum ada yang menganggap pengembalian dana tersebut adalah milik mereka.

segments.src: 5. **Talk to your auditor early** about recognition timing so the refund does not become a surprise restatement conversation.
segments.tr: 5. **Bicaralah dengan auditor Anda lebih awal** tentang waktu pengakuan sehingga pengembalian dana tidak menjadi pembicaraan restatemen yang mengejutkan.

segments.src: 6. **Model the replacement duties**, not the old ones. Your forward cost curve depends on Section 232 scopes, not on a case you already won.
segments.tr: 6. **Buat model bea pengganti**, bukan bea lama. Kurva biaya masa depan Anda bergantung pada ruang lingkup Pasal 232, bukan pada kasus yang sudah Anda menangkan.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: The Supreme Court answered a constitutional question cleanly: an emergency-powers statute that never mentions tariffs does not authorize them.
segments.tr: Mahkamah Agung menjawab pertanyaan konstitusional secara bersih: undang-undang wewenang darurat yang tidak pernah menyebutkan tarif tidak memberikan wewenang untuk itu.

segments.src: What it could not do is make an administrative system built for correcting individual entry errors process a nationwide reversal quickly, or prevent the executive branch from rebuilding similar duties through statutes that were always available and are now being used.
segments.tr: Apa yang tidak dapat dilakukannya adalah membuat sistem administratif yang dibangun untuk mengoreksi kesalahan entri individu memproses pembalikan nasional dengan cepat, atau mencegah cabang eksekutif membangun kembali bea serupa melalui undang-undang yang selalu tersedia dan sekarang sedang digunakan.

segments.src: For 330,000 companies, the ruling converted a cost into a receivable.
segments.tr: Bagi 330.000 perusahaan, keputusan tersebut mengubah biaya menjadi piutang.

segments.src: That is a genuine improvement.
segments.tr: Itu adalah peningkatan yang nyata.

segments.src: It is also a reminder that in trade law, the judgment is the beginning of the process, not the end of it — and that the distance between a court order and a bank deposit is measured in liquidation dates, not in principles.
segments.tr: Ini juga merupakan pengingat bahwa dalam hukum perdagangan, putusan pengadilan adalah awal dari proses, bukan akhir darinya — dan bahwa jarak antara perintah pengadilan dan setoran bank diukur dalam tanggal likuidasi, bukan dalam prinsip.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not legal, tax, or accounting advice.
segments.tr: *Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum, bukan nasihat hukum, pajak, atau akuntansi.

segments.src: Figures cited are estimates that shift as litigation and refund processing continue.
segments.tr: Angka-angka yang dikutip adalah estimasi yang dapat berubah seiring berlanjutnya litigasi dan pemrosesan pengembalian dana.

segments.src: Importers with potential claims should consult licensed customs counsel and their own advisors about their specific entries and deadlines.*
segments.tr: Pengimpor dengan potensi klaim harus berkonsultasi dengan penasihat bea cukai berlisensi dan penasihat mereka sendiri tentang entri dan tenggat waktu spesifik mereka.*

ja.title: 最高裁で勝訴、しかし小切手はまだ届かない：誰も回収できない1,650億ドルの関税還付金の内部事情

segments.src: There is a peculiar kind of legal victory in which you win everything and receive nothing.
segments.tr: すべてに勝ちながら、何も得られないという奇妙な法的勝利があります。

segments.src: Somewhere around 330,000 American importers are living in it right now.
segments.tr: 現在、約33万社の米国輸入業者がその状況にあります。

segments.src: Six months after the Supreme Court held, 6–3, that the International Emergency Economic Powers Act does not give any president the authority to impose tariffs, the courts have ordered roughly $165 billion in collected duties returned to the companies that paid them.
segments.tr: 最高裁判所が、国際緊急経済権限法（IEEPA）は大統領に関税を課す権限を与えていないと6対3で判決を下してから6ヶ月後、裁判所は、支払われた関税として約1,650億ドルを支払った企業に返還することを命じました。

segments.src: On paper, that is one of the largest single refund events the U.S.
segments.tr: 書類上では、これは米国財務省がこれまで直面した中で

segments.src: Treasury has ever faced.
segments.tr: 最大規模の単一還付イベントの一つです。

segments.src: In practice, most of the businesses entitled to that money have not seen a dollar of it — and a large share of them are still cutting tariff checks every week.
segments.tr: 実際には、その資金を受け取る権利がある企業のほとんどが1ドルも受け取っておらず、その多くは今でも毎週関税の小切手を切り続けています。

segments.src: The gap between the ruling and the refund is not a scandal.
segments.tr: 判決と還付の間のギャップは、スキャンダルではありません。

segments.src: It is plumbing.
segments.tr: それは「配管（仕組み）」の問題です。

segments.src: But the plumbing is worth understanding, because it explains why a landmark constitutional decision has so far changed far less about the cost of importing goods into the United States than the headline suggested.
segments.tr: しかし、この仕組みを理解することは重要です。なぜなら、画期的な憲法上の決定が、見出しが示唆していたよりも、米国への商品輸入コストにほとんど影響を与えていない理由を説明してくれるからです。

segments.src: ## What the Court actually decided
segments.tr: ## 裁判所が実際に決定したこと

segments.src: IEEPA, passed in 1977, lets a president declare a national emergency in response to an "unusual and extraordinary threat" originating largely outside the United States, and then take a list of economic actions — among them, the authority to "regulate ...
segments.tr: 1977年に制定されたIEEPAは、主に米国国外で発生した「異常かつ特別な脅威」に対応して大統領が国家緊急事態を宣言し、経済的措置のリストを実行することを認めており、その中には「規制...」

segments.src: importation."
segments.tr: 「輸入」する権限が含まれています。

segments.src: The government's argument rested on those three words.
segments.tr: 政府の主張は、この3つの言葉に基づいたものでした。

segments.src: If you can regulate importation, the reasoning went, you can condition importation on payment of a duty.
segments.tr: 輸入を規制できるのであれば、関税の支払いを輸入の条件にできるという論理です。

segments.src: Emergencies are unpredictable, and Congress wrote the statute broadly on purpose.
segments.tr: 緊急事態は予測不可能であり、議会は意図的に法律を広範に記述しました。

segments.src: The challengers — a group of small importers and a coalition of states, whose cases were consolidated on the way up — made a structural argument instead.
segments.tr: 一方、原告側（小規模輸入業者グループと州の連合で、上訴過程で統合されたケース）は、構造的な主張を展開しました。

segments.src: The power to lay duties belongs to Congress under Article I.
segments.tr: 関税を課す権限は、憲法第1条に基づき議会に属します。

segments.src: IEEPA never uses the words *tariff*, *duty*, or *tax*.
segments.tr: IEEPAには、「関税（tariff）」、「税（duty）」、「税金（tax）」という言葉は一度も使われていません。

segments.src: And in nearly fifty years, across administrations of both parties, no president had ever read the statute that way.
segments.tr: そして、約50年間にわたり、両党の政権を通じて、この法律をそのように解釈した大統領は一人もいませんでした。

segments.src: The majority sided with the challengers, applying the now-familiar principle that Congress does not hide decisions of vast economic and political significance inside vague or ancillary statutory language.
segments.tr: 多数派は原告側に寄り、議会が膨大な経済的・政治的重要性を持つ決定を、曖昧な、あるいは付随的な法律の文言の中に隠すことはないという、今や周知の原則を適用しました。

segments.src: The Court noted something telling: when Congress *has* delegated tariff authority, it has done so deliberately and with guardrails — required investigations, agency findings, rate ceilings, sunset clauses.
segments.tr: 裁判所は、ある注目すべき点に言及しました。議会が関税権限を委任した際は、常に意図的に、そしてガードレール（調査の義務付け、当局の認定、上限率、サンセット条項など）を設けて行ってきたということです。

segments.src: IEEPA has none of those.
segments.tr: IEEPAには、それらが一切ありません。

segments.src: The absence of any procedural machinery was treated as evidence that the machinery was never meant to be there.
segments.tr: 手続き上の仕組みが欠如していることは、そのような仕組みが最初から意図されていなかった証拠として扱われました。

segments.src: The dissent argued for deference in the field of foreign affairs, and read "regulate importation" as plainly capacious enough to include a tariff.
segments.tr: 反対意見では、外交分野における尊重を主張し、「輸入を規制する」という言葉は、明らかに十分な広さを持っており、関税を含むと解釈しました。

segments.src: One point gets lost in the coverage: the decision is about *which branch* sets tariffs and *under which statute*.
segments.tr: 報道の中で見落とされがちな点があります。この決定は、「どの機関が」関税を設定し、「どの法律に基づいて」設定するかということについてです。

segments.src: It is not a ruling on whether tariffs are wise policy.
segments.tr: 関税が賢明な政策であるかどうかについての裁定ではありません。

segments.src: That distinction explains nearly everything that has happened since.
segments.tr: この区別が、その後起こったほぼすべての出来事を説明しています。

segments.src: ## Why winning is not the same as being paid
segments.tr: ## 勝訴することが支払われることと同じではない理由

segments.src: Customs refunds do not work like a court-ordered settlement where a check gets mailed.
segments.tr: 税関の還付金は、小切手が郵送される裁判所命令の和解金のような仕組みではありません。

segments.src: They work entry by entry, through a system built for correcting individual paperwork errors, not for unwinding a policy applied to tens of millions of shipments.
segments.tr: 還付は、個別の書類ミスを修正するために構築されたシステムを通じて、エントリー（輸入申告）ごとに処理されます。数千万件の出荷に適用された政策を白紙に戻すためのシステムではありません。

segments.src: **Liquidation is the deadline nobody outside the trade world had heard of.** When goods enter the United States, the importer files an entry summary and deposits estimated duties.
segments.tr: **リクイデーション（精算）は、貿易業界以外の人には聞いたこともない締め切りです。** 商品が米国に入った際、輸入業者はエントリーサマリーを提出し、推定関税を預託します。

segments.src: Months later, Customs and Border Protection "liquidates" the entry — the final, legally binding computation of what was owed.
segments.tr: 数ヶ月後、税関・国境警備局（CBP）がエントリーを「リクイデーション（精算）」させます。これは、支払われるべき金額の最終的で法的拘束力のある計算です。

segments.src: Once an entry liquidates and the protest window closes, it is generally final.
segments.tr: 一度エントリーが精算され、不服申し立て（プロテスト）の期間が終了すると、通常は確定します。

segments.src: Reopening it requires a specific legal hook.
segments.tr: それを再開するには、特定の法的根拠が必要です。

segments.src: Many entries from the tariffs' earliest months liquidated long before the case reached the Supreme Court, and a meaningful slice of the theoretical $165 billion sits behind that door.
segments.tr: 関税導入初期の多くのエントリーは、ケースが最高裁に届くずっと前に精算されており、理論上の1,650億ドルのかなりの部分が、その扉の向こう側にあります。

segments.src: **Being right is not the same as being a party.** Court orders run to the parties before the court.
segments.tr: **正しいことが、当事者であることと同じではない。** 裁判所の命令は、裁判前の当事者に適用されます。

segments.src: Whether relief extends automatically to every importer in the country, or whether each company must file its own protest or suit to claim its share, has been litigated separately — and that secondary fight is where a great deal of the money is currently parked.
segments.tr: 救済措置が国内のすべての輸入業者に自動的に適用されるのか、あるいは各社が自分の取り分を請求するために個別に不服申し立てや訴訟を起こす必要があるのかについては、別途争われており、現在多くの資金がその二次的な争いの段階で止まっています。

segments.src: Importers who filed protective claims early are in a materially better position than those who waited for the news.
segments.tr: 早期に保護的な請求を行った輸入業者は、ニュースを待っていた業者よりも実質的に有利な立場にあります。

segments.src: **The refund itself is an accounting exercise at enormous scale.** CBP processes tens of millions of entry summaries a year.
segments.tr: **還付自体が、膨大な規模の会計作業です。** CBPは年間数千万件のエントリーサマリーを処理しています。

segments.src: Each refund has to be matched to a specific entry, a specific line, a specific tariff classification, and often a specific surety bond.
segments.tr: 各還付金は、特定のエントリー、特定の行、特定の関税分類、そして多くの場合、特定の保証債券と照合される必要があります。

segments.src: Some entries mixed duties that are now void with duties that remain perfectly valid under other statutes.
segments.tr: 一部のエントリーでは、現在は無効となった関税と、他の法律に基づいて完全に有効なままの関税が混在しています。

segments.src: Untangling those lines is manual work, and there is no button that does it.
segments.tr: これらの行を解きほぐすのは手作業であり、それを自動的に行うボタンはありません。

segments.src: **Interest accrues, which softens the wait but complicates the math.** Excess deposits generally carry interest from the date of deposit until refund, at rates Treasury resets quarterly.
segments.tr: **利息が発生し、待ち時間は緩和されますが、計算は複雑になります。** 過剰預託金には通常、預託日から還付日まで、財務省が四半期ごとに設定する利率で利息がつきます。

segments.src: For a company that paid millions in 2025, that is real money — and also a taxable event landing in a different fiscal year than the original expense.
segments.tr: 2025年に数百万ドルを支払った企業にとって、それは実質的な金額であり、また、元の費用とは異なる会計年度に計上される課税対象イベントとなります。

segments.src: **Appeals and remands keep resetting the clock.** Even after a Supreme Court ruling on the core question, the downstream cases about scope, timing, and eligibility continue to move through the Court of International Trade and the Federal Circuit.
segments.tr: **上訴と差し戻しが時計をリセットし続けます。** 核心的な問題に関する最高裁の判決後も、範囲、タイミング、資格に関する下流のケースは、国際貿易裁判所と連邦巡回裁判所を動き続けています。

segments.src: Every remand adds months.
segments.tr: 差し戻しが発生するたびに、数ヶ月が追加されます。

segments.src: ## Who actually gets the money
segments.tr: ## 実際に誰がお金を受け取るのか

segments.src: This is the question that produces the most awkward conversations inside companies.
segments.tr: これは、社内で最も気まずい会話を生む質問です。

segments.src: The refund goes to the **importer of record** — the entity legally on the hook to CBP.
segments.tr: 還付金は、**輸入記録上の輸入者（importer of record）**、つまりCBPに対して法的に責任を負う主体に支払われます。

segments.src: That is often not the party that ultimately bore the cost.
segments.tr: それは、最終的にコストを負担した当事者ではないことが多いです。

segments.src: A U.S.
segments.tr: 関税を支払い、価格を上げた米国の

segments.src: distributor that paid the duty and raised its prices has already recovered much of it from customers.
segments.tr: 卸売業者は、すでに顧客からその多くを回収しています。

segments.src: A retailer that negotiated delivered-duty-paid terms may have pushed the cost onto a foreign supplier.
segments.tr: DDP（関税込み持ち込み渡し）条件で交渉した小売業者は、コストを海外サプライヤーに転嫁した可能性があります。

segments.src: Some contracts contain explicit tariff-adjustment clauses that now run in reverse; most do not.
segments.tr: 一部の契約には、現在逆方向に機能する明示的な関税調整条項が含まれていますが、ほとんどは含まれていません。

segments.src: The result is a wave of quiet commercial negotiation that has nothing to do with the constitutional question: *who, in this supply chain, owns this receivable?* Companies with clean documentation and well-drafted clauses are resolving it in weeks.
segments.tr: その結果、憲法上の問題とは無関係な、静かな商業的交渉の波が押し寄せています。「このサプライチェーンの中で、この債権は誰のものか？」という問いです。適切な文書化と適切に起草された条項を持つ企業は、数週間で解決しています。

segments.src: Companies without are discovering that a windfall is only a windfall if you can prove it is yours.
segments.tr: それらを持たない企業は、棚ぼたの利益は、それが自分のものであると証明できなければ、単なる棚ぼたに過ぎないことに気づいています。

segments.src: ## The wall that replaced the wall
segments.tr: ## 壁に代わって現れた壁

segments.src: Here is the part that surprises people who followed only the headline.
segments.tr: 見出しだけを追っていた人々を驚かせるのがこの部分です。

segments.src: For many importers, the total duty burden has not fallen much, because the tariffs did not disappear so much as change legal address.
segments.tr: 多くの輸入業者にとって、総関税負担はあまり減っていません。なぜなら、関税が消えたのではなく、法的な住所が変わっただけだからです。

segments.src: IEEPA was the fast lane.
segments.tr: IEEPAは特急車線でした。

segments.src: Everything else is slower, narrower, and procedurally demanding — but it exists, and it has been used.
segments.tr: それ以外のものはすべて、より遅く、より狭く、手続き的に要求が多いですが、それでも存在し、使用されてきました。

segments.src: | Authority | What it requires | Practical constraints |
segments.tr: | 権限 | 必要条件 | 実務上の制約 |

segments.src: | **Section 232** (Trade Expansion Act of 1962) | Commerce Department investigation finding that imports threaten national security | Product-by-product; investigations take months; no statutory rate cap |
segments.tr: | **第232条** (1962年貿易拡大法) | 輸入が国家安全保障を脅かすという商務省の調査結果 | 製品ごと。調査に数ヶ月かかる。法定の上限率なし |

segments.src: | **Section 301** (Trade Act of 1974) | USTR investigation into unfair foreign practices | Country-specific; notice-and-comment; subject to periodic review |
segments.tr: | **第301条** (1974年貿易法) | 不公正な外国慣行に関するUSTRの調査 | 国別。告知およびコメント手続き。定期的なレビューの対象 |

segments.src: | **Section 201** (Trade Act of 1974) | ITC finding of serious injury to a domestic industry | Temporary safeguard; must phase down over time |
segments.tr: | **第201条** (1974年貿易法) | 国内産業への重大な損害というITCの認定 | 一時的なセーフガード。時間の経過とともに段階的に削減する必要がある |

segments.src: | **Section 122** (Trade Act of 1974) | Balance-of-payments justification | Capped at 15% and 150 days without congressional action |
segments.tr: | **第122条** (1974年貿易法) | 国際収支の正当化 | 議会の措置なしに15%および150日を上限とする |

segments.src: Section 232 has done most of the work.
segments.tr: 第232条が最も多くの役割を果たしてきました。

segments.src: Because it is organized around product categories rather than countries, rebuilding coverage means running investigations sector by sector — steel and aluminum derivatives, autos and parts, copper, timber and lumber, pharmaceuticals, semiconductors and downstream electronics.
segments.tr: それは国別ではなく製品カテゴリーに基づいて構成されているため、適用範囲を再構築するには、セクターごとに調査を行う必要があります。鉄鋼およびアルミニウム誘導体、自動車および部品、銅、木材および材木、医薬品、半導体および下流電子機器などです。

segments.src: Each one is a separate proceeding with its own comment docket and its own effective date.
segments.tr: それぞれが個別の手続きであり、独自のコメントドケットと発効日を持っています。

segments.src: The practical effect for an importer is that a refund for last year's duties can arrive in the same quarter as a new invoice for this year's, on the same product, at a comparable rate, under a different statute.
segments.tr: 輸入業者にとっての実務的な影響は、昨年の関税の還付金が、同じ製品で、同等の率で、別の法律に基づいて、今年の新しい請求書と同じ四半期に届く可能性があるということです。

segments.src: The money is real.
segments.tr: お金は本物です。

segments.src: The relief is not.
segments.tr: しかし、救済は本物ではありません。

segments.src: ## What it means for the books
segments.tr: ## 会計上の意味

segments.src: Accountants have been unusually vocal about this one.
segments.tr: 会計士たちは、この件について異例なほど声を上げてきました。

segments.src: Under U.S.
segments.tr: 米国の

segments.src: GAAP, gain contingencies generally are not recognized until realized or realizable — so a company cannot simply book its expected refund as an asset because it read a favorable opinion.
segments.tr: GAAP（一般に認められた会計原則）では、利得の偶発事象は、通常、実現または実現可能になるまで認識されません。したがって、企業は好意的な意見を読んだだけで、期待される還付金を資産として計上することはできません。

segments.src: The original tariffs were typically expensed through cost of goods sold or capitalized into inventory.
segments.tr: 元の関税は通常、売上原価を通じて費用処理されるか、在庫に組み込まれていました。

segments.src: The refunds, when they land, tend to arrive as a lump in a later period, distorting margins in a quarter that had nothing to do with the shipments in question.
segments.tr: 還付金が届いたとき、それは後の期間に一括して届く傾向があり、問題の出荷とは無関係な四半期の利益率を歪めることになります。

segments.src: That timing mismatch is why some importers with large confirmed claims still look, on paper, like they are absorbing tariff costs.
segments.tr: このタイミングの不一致が、大規模な確定請求権を持つ一部の輸入業者が、書類上では依然として関税コストを吸収しているように見える理由です。

segments.src: They are — until the money moves.
segments.tr: 実際にはそうですが、お金が動くまではそうです。

segments.src: ## What it means for prices
segments.tr: ## 価格への影響

segments.src: Prices are famously sticky downward.
segments.tr: 価格は、下落しにくい（sticky downward）ことで有名です。

segments.src: Costs that got passed to consumers over two years do not reverse on the day a court rules, particularly when replacement duties are landing in the same categories.
segments.tr: 2年かけて消費者に転嫁されたコストは、裁判所が判決を下した日に逆転することはありません。特に、代替関税が同じカテゴリーに適用される場合です。

segments.src: Where relief has shown up fastest is in goods that fell outside every Section 232 product scope — certain consumer categories, some apparel and household goods, various inputs with no plausible national-security framing.
segments.tr: 救済が最も早く現れたのは、第232条のすべての製品範囲外となった商品です。特定の消費者カテゴリー、一部の衣類や家庭用品、国家安全保障の枠組みに当てはまらない様々な投入物などです。

segments.src: Where it has shown up least is anywhere touching metals, vehicles, electronics, or pharmaceuticals.
segments.tr: 最も現れなかったのは、金属、車両、電子機器、または医薬品に関わるあらゆる場所です。

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 次に注目すべき点

segments.src: - **The scope litigation.** Whether relief reaches non-parties automatically is worth more, in dollars, than most of the underlying case.
segments.tr: - **範囲に関する訴訟。** 救済が非当事者に自動的に及ぶかどうかが、元のケースのほとんどよりも、金額ベースで大きな価値を持ちます。

segments.src: - **The liquidation cutoff rulings.** Courts are being asked whether finality bars claims on entries that liquidated before the decision. This is the single largest variable in the $165 billion estimate.
segments.tr: - **リクイデーションの締め切りに関する裁定。** 判決前の精算済みエントリーに対する請求権が、確定性の原則によって妨げられるかどうかが問われています。これは、1,650億ドルの見積もりにおける最大の変数です。

segments.src: - **CBP's processing pace.** Refund throughput, not legal entitlement, now sets the calendar for most companies.
segments.tr: - **CBPの処理速度。** 法的な権利ではなく、還付金の処理能力が、現在多くの企業にとってのスケジュールを決定しています。

segments.src: - **New Section 232 proceedings.** Each new product scope narrows the practical benefit of the refund for affected importers.
segments.tr: - **新しい第232条の手続き。** 新しい製品範囲が設定されるたびに、影響を受ける輸入業者にとっての還付金の実際的なメリットが狭まります。

segments.src: - **Congress.** The decision hands tariff-setting back to the legislature by default. Whether Congress legislates new delegated authority, tightens the existing ones, or does nothing will determine what the next version of this looks like.
segments.tr: - **議会。** この決定は、デフォルトで関税設定権限を立法府に戻しました。議会が新しい委任権限を法制化するか、既存のものを強化するか、あるいは何もしないかによって、次のバージョンがどのようになるかが決まります。

segments.src: ## A practical checklist for importers
segments.tr: ## 輸入業者のための実務的なチェックリスト

segments.src: If your company imported during the affected period, the useful steps are unglamorous:
segments.tr: 影響を受けた期間に輸入を行った企業は、地味なステップを踏む必要があります。

segments.src: 1. **Pull your entry data.** Identify every entry summary in the window and its liquidation status. You cannot claim what you cannot locate.
segments.tr: 1. **エントリーデータの抽出。** 期間内のすべてのエントリーサマリーとその精算状況を確認してください。特定できないものは請求できません。

segments.src: 2. **Preserve rights on unliquidated entries** through the appropriate protest or post-summary correction channels, with customs counsel, before deadlines pass.
segments.tr: 2. **未精算エントリーの権利保持。** 締め切りが過ぎる前に、税関弁護士とともに、適切な不服申し立て（プロテスト）またはサマリー後修正（PSC）チャネルを通じて権利を保持してください。

segments.src: 3. **Separate voided duties from valid ones** line by line. Mixed entries are the most common source of rejected claims.
segments.tr: t: 3. **無効となった関税と有効な関税の分離。** 行ごとに分離してください。混在エントリーは、請求が却下される最も一般的な原因です。

segments.src: 4. **Read your contracts** for tariff pass-through and adjustment clauses, in both directions, before anyone assumes the refund is theirs.
segments.tr: 4. **契約書の確認。** 還付金が誰のものかと想定する前に、双方向の関税転嫁および調整条項を確認してください。

segments.src: 5. **Talk to your auditor early** about recognition timing so the refund does not become a surprise restatement conversation.
segments.tr: 5. **監査人に早期相談。** 認識タイミングについて相談し、還付金が突然の再表示（restatement）の議論になるのを避けてください。

segments.src: 6. **Model the replacement duties**, not the old ones. Your forward cost curve depends on Section 232 scopes, not on a case you already won.
segments.tr: 6. **代替関税のモデル化。** 旧関税ではなく、新しい関税をモデル化してください。今後のコスト曲線は、すでに勝訴したケースではなく、第232条の範囲に依存します。

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The Supreme Court answered a constitutional question cleanly: an emergency-powers statute that never mentions tariffs does not authorize them.
segments.tr: 最高裁判所は、憲法上の問いに明確に答えました。関税に一度も言及していない緊急権限法は、関税を認めるものではありません。

segments.src: What it could not do is make an administrative system built for correcting individual entry errors process a nationwide reversal quickly, or prevent the executive branch from rebuilding similar duties through statutes that were always available and are now being used.
segments.tr: しかし、個別のエントリーエラーを修正するために構築された行政システムが、全国的な逆転を迅速に処理できることや、行政権が、常に利用可能であり、現在使用されている他の法律を通じて同様の関税を再構築することを防ぐことはできませんでした。

segments.src: For 330,000 companies, the ruling converted a cost into a receivable.
segments.tr: 33万社にとって、この判決はコストを債権に変換しました。

segments.src: That is a genuine improvement.
segments.tr: それは純粋な改善です。

segments.src: It is also a reminder that in trade law, the judgment is the beginning of the process, not the end of it — and that the distance between a court order and a bank deposit is measured in liquidation dates, not in principles.
segments.tr: それはまた、貿易法において、判決はプロセスの終わりではなく始まりであり、裁判所の命令と銀行口座への入金の間には、原則ではなく、リクイデーション（精算）日という距離があることを思い出させてくれます。

segments.src: *This article is general information, not legal, tax, or accounting advice.
segments.tr: *この記事は一般的な情報であり、法的、税務的、または会計的なアドバイスではありません。

segments.src: Figures cited are estimates that shift as litigation and refund processing continue.
segments.tr: 引用された数値は、訴訟と還付処理が続くにつれて変動する見積もりです。

segments.src: Importers with potential claims should consult licensed customs counsel and their own advisors about their specific entries and deadlines.*
segments.tr: 請求権を持つ可能性のある輸入業者は、公認の税関弁護士および自身のアドバイザーに、特定のエントリーと締め切りについて相談してください。*

de.title: Sieg vor dem Supreme Court, aber immer noch auf den Scheck warten: Ein Blick hinter die Kulissen der 165 Milliarden Dollar Zollrückerstattung, die niemand einfordern kann

segments.src: There is a peculiar kind of legal victory in which you win everything and receive nothing.
segments.tr: Es gibt eine eigentümliche Art von juristischem Sieg, bei dem man alles gewinnt und nichts erhält.

segments.src: Somewhere around 330,000 American importers are living in it right now.
segments.tr: Etwa 330.000 amerikanische Importeure leben derzeit genau darin.

segments.src: Six months after the Supreme Court held, 6–3, that the International Emergency Economic Powers Act does not give any president the authority to impose tariffs, the courts have ordered roughly $165 billion in collected duties returned to the companies that paid them.
segments.tr: Sechs Monate nachdem der Supreme Court mit 6 zu 3 entschied, dass der International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) keinem Präsidenten die Befugnis gibt, Zölle zu erheben, haben die Gerichte angeordnet, dass etwa 165 Milliarden Dollar an eingezogenen Zöllen an die Unternehmen zurückgezahlt werden, die sie bezahlt haben.

segments.src: On paper, that is one of the largest single refund events the U.S.
segments.tr: Auf dem Papier ist dies eine der größten einzelnen Rückerstattungsaktionen, mit denen das US-

segments.src: Treasury has ever faced.
segments.tr: Finanzministerium (Treasury) jemals konfrontiert war.

segments.src: In practice, most of the businesses entitled to that money have not seen a dollar of it — and a large share of them are still cutting tariff checks every week.
segments.tr: In der Praxis haben die meisten Unternehmen, denen dieses Geld zusteht, keinen einzigen Dollar davon gesehen – und ein großer Teil von ihnen zahlt jede Woche immer noch Zollchecks aus.

segments.src: The gap between the ruling and the refund is not a scandal.
segments.tr: Die Lücke zwischen dem Urteil und der Rückerstattung ist kein Skandal.

segments.src: It is plumbing.
segments.tr: Es ist eine Frage der administrativen Abläufe (Plumbing).

segments.src: But the plumbing is worth understanding, because it explains why a landmark constitutional decision has so far changed far less about the cost of importing goods into the United States than the headline suggested.
segments.tr: Aber diese Abläufe sind es wert, verstanden zu werden, denn sie erklären, warum eine bahnbrechende verfassungsrechtliche Entscheidung bisher viel weniger an den Kosten für den Import von Waren in die Vereinigten Staaten geändert hat, als die Schlagzeilen vermuten ließen.

segments.src: ## What the Court actually decided
segments.tr: ## Was das Gericht tatsächlich entschieden hat

segments.src: IEEPA, passed in 1977, lets a president declare a national emergency in response to an "unusual and extraordinary threat" originating largely outside the United States, and then take a list of economic actions — among them, the authority to "regulate ...
segments.tr: Der IEEPA, verabschiedet 1977, erlaubt es einem Präsidenten, als Reaktion auf eine „ungewöhnliche und außergewöhnliche Bedrohung“, die größtenteils außerhalb der Vereinigten Staaten ihren Ursprung hat, den nationalen Notstand auszurufen und dann eine Liste wirtschaftlicher Maßnahmen zu ergreifen – darunter die Befugnis, die „Regulierung der...

segments.src: importation."
segments.tr: Einfuhr" zu steuern.

segments.src: The government's argument rested on those three words.
segments.tr: Das Argument der Regierung stützte sich auf diese drei Worte.

segments.src: If you can regulate importation, the reasoning went, you can condition importation on payment of a duty.
segments.tr: Wenn man die Einfuhr regulieren kann, so lautete die Begründung, dann kann man die Einfuhr an die Zahlung eines Zolls knüpfen.

segments.src: Emergencies are unpredictable, and Congress wrote the statute broadly on purpose.
segments.tr: Notfälle sind unvorhersehbar, und der Kongress hat das Gesetz bewusst breit gefasst.

segments.src: The challengers — a group of small importers and a coalition of states, whose cases were consolidated on the way up — made a structural argument instead.
segments.tr: Die Kläger – eine Gruppe kleiner Importeure und eine Koalition von Bundesstaaten, deren Fälle auf dem Weg nach oben zusammengelegt wurden – führten stattdessen ein strukturelles Argument an.

segments.src: The power to lay duties belongs to Congress under Article I.
segments.tr: Die Befugnis, Zölle zu erheben, liegt gemäß Artikel I beim Kongress.

segments.src: IEEPA never uses the words *tariff*, *duty*, or *tax*.
segments.tr: Der IEEPA verwendet niemals die Wörter *Zoll* (tariff), *Abgabe* (duty) oder *Steuer* (tax).

segments.src: And in nearly fifty years, across administrations of both parties, no president had ever read the statute that way.
segments.tr: Und in fast fünfzig Jahren, über Regierungen beider Parteien hinweg, hatte kein Präsident das Gesetz jemals so ausgelegt.

segments.src: The majority sided with the challengers, applying the now-familiar principle that Congress does not hide decisions of vast economic and political significance inside vague or ancillary statutory language.
segments.tr: Die Mehrheit schloss sich den Klägern an und wandte das nun bekannte Prinzip an, dass der Kongress Entscheidungen von enormer wirtschaftlicher und politischer Bedeutung nicht in vagen oder untergeordneten gesetzlichen Formulierungen versteckt.

segments.src: The Court noted something telling: when Congress *has* delegated tariff authority, it has done so deliberately and with guardrails — required investigations, agency findings, rate ceilings, sunset clauses.
segments.tr: Das Gericht stellte etwas Aufschlussreiches fest: Wenn der Kongress Zollbefugnisse delegiert *hat*, dann tat er dies bewusst und mit Leitplanken – erforderliche Untersuchungen, Feststellungen der Behörden, Höchstsätze, Auslaufklauseln.

segments.src: IEEPA has none of those.
segments.tr: Der IEEPA hat keine dieser Maßnahmen.

segments.src: The absence of any procedural machinery was treated as evidence that the machinery was never meant to be there.
segments.tr: Das Fehlen jeglicher verfahrenstechnischer Mechanismen wurde als Beweis dafür gewertet, dass diese Mechanismen nie vorgesehen waren.

segments.src: The dissent argued for deference in the field of foreign affairs, and read "regulate importation" as plainly capacious enough to include a tariff.
segments.tr: Das Minderheitsvotum plädierte für Zurückhaltung im Bereich der Außenpolitik und interpretierte „Regulierung der Einfuhr“ als offensichtlich weit genug gefasst, um einen Zoll einzuschließen.

segments.src: One point gets lost in the coverage: the decision is about *which branch* sets tariffs and *under which statute*.
segments.tr: Ein Punkt geht in der Berichterstattung verloren: Die Entscheidung betrifft *welche Instanz* Zölle festlegt und *auf welcher gesetzlichen Grundlage*.

segments.src: It is not a ruling on whether tariffs are wise policy.
segments.tr: Es ist kein Urteil darüber, ob Zölle eine kluge Politik sind.
